title: Video Editor — AI UGC / Ecom Ads
description:
Type: Full-time, long-term

Pay: $1,000–$1,500/month retainer + leaderboard performance bonuses

Hours: ~40/week, Monday–Friday (weekends optional but encouraged)

Location: Fully remote





------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT THIS IS

------------------------------------------------------------

I'm hiring a direct response video editor to join our creative team. You'd come

in as an editor — but I do need someone who already has solid experience and a

strong skillset, not a beginner. Full-time and long-term for the right person,

not a one-off gig.





------------------------------------------------------------

ABOUT US

------------------------------------------------------------

You'll be working with a fast-growing health and wellness brand scaling hard in

the US market. We run a huge creative team that ships a high volume of paid ad

creatives every week, and we spend serious money on ads — so the work you make

actually goes out and gets tested at scale. You'll see real numbers on your

edits, not just upload and forget.





------------------------------------------------------------

WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

------------------------------------------------------------

A direct response editor who makes ads built to perform, not just look nice. If

you've only ever done pretty edits with no understanding of what makes an ad

convert, this probably isn't for you.



You should be able to cut these ad styles confidently:



  - AI UGC ads

  - Voiceover + b-roll style ads

  - Greenscreen / AI avatar style

  - Claymation / Pixar / 3D animation style

  - Podcast-style ads

  - And honestly, whatever style is winning right now



You'll be making a high volume of AI-generated creative — AI UGC, claymation,

Pixar-style, podcast ads, avatars, and more — so you need to be genuinely

comfortable producing and blending AI generative assets into ads that convert.





------------------------------------------------------------

THE ACTUAL EDITING SKILLS YOU NEED

------------------------------------------------------------

This is the part people usually leave vague, so let me be specific. Day to day,

you'll need to be genuinely good at:



  HOOKS & RETENTION EDITING

  You understand the first 3 seconds make or break an ad. You know how to open

  strong, hold attention with pattern interrupts, zooms, jump cuts, and pacing,

  and keep someone watching to the CTA.



  PACING & RHYTHM

  You cut to the energy of the voiceover/script — tight where it needs to be,

  never letting a clip drag. Your edits feel fast and snappy without being messy.



  STORYTELLING TO A SCRIPT

  You can take a VO or ad script and build the visual story around it: matching

  b-roll, on-screen text, and beats to what's being said so the message actually

  lands.



  B-ROLL SOURCING & SEQUENCING

  You know how to find (or generate) the right supporting footage and place it so

  it reinforces the message, not just fills space.



  CAPTIONS & ON-SCREEN TEXT

  Clean, readable, well-timed subtitles and kinetic text — styled to match the

  brand, synced properly, and used to drive retention (not just slapped on).



  SOUND DESIGN

  Music selection that fits the mood, proper audio leveling, SFX and "whooshes"

  on transitions, ducking music under VO. Bad audio kills good visuals.



  BASIC MOTION GRAPHICS & TEXT ANIMATION

  Simple, clean animated text, callouts, highlights, and transitions that look

  professional.



  COLOR & CLEANUP

  Basic correction so clips match and look consistent, plus a clean, polished

  finish (no jarring cuts, no random aspect-ratio jumps).



  AI GENERATION

  You can actually prompt and produce usable assets — AI UGC clips, claymation,

  Pixar-style, avatars, b-roll, images — and blend them into a real ad so it

  doesn't look obviously AI.



  ORGANIZATION

  Named files, tidy project structure, hitting deadlines. You make it easy for

  the team to work with you.





------------------------------------------------------------

TOOLS YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW

------------------------------------------------------------

CapCut, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling, Veo 3, Nano Banana, Higgsfield — and whatever

else is current in the gen-AI stack. This space changes every single week and I

need someone who actually keeps up, not someone I have to drag along.





------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT YOU'LL OWN (KPIs)

------------------------------------------------------------

  DAILY OUTPUT: 1–3+ high-quality ad creatives per day, following our scripts

  and styles.



  70% FIRST-PASS APPROVAL RATE: At least 7 out of 10 of your submissions should

  require no revisions — meaning they match the brief and are ready to test.



  AVAILABILITY: Online and responsive Monday–Friday. Weekends are optional but

  encouraged for the people who want to climb the leaderboard faster.





------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT MATTERS MOST (BEYOND THE SKILLS)

------------------------------------------------------------

  - DTC experience is a must. You've already worked with one or more DTC / ecom

    brands — this is non-negotiable. Show me the work.



  - You use AI tools daily and stay updated as new ones drop.



  - Mindset — this is the big one. Coachable, fast learner, growth-oriented, and

    the type who tries to overdeliver instead of doing the bare minimum.



You don't have to be perfect on day one. But you should be good enough to hit

the ground running and hungry enough to keep leveling up. We've got a head editor

who'll guide you on frameworks, hook structures, and what actually makes an ad

win — so this is a genuine chance to learn ecom and direct response from the

inside while getting paid well to do it.





------------------------------------------------------------

COMPENSATION

------------------------------------------------------------

Base retainer: $1,000–$1,500/month, depending on your skill level and

experience. Retainers go up over time as your skills grow and you take on more

responsibility.



Leaderboard bonuses — on top of your retainer. Here's how it works: the editor

with the highest number of winning ads gets first place, and so on. The whole

team is ranked on a leaderboard each month, and the top 5 editors get paid

bonuses on top of their base. The better your creatives perform, the higher you

climb, the more you earn.



  ???? 1st place: $[500]

  ???? 2nd place: $[400]

  ???? 3rd place: $[300]

  4?? 4th place: $[200]

  5?? 5th place: $[100]



We spend at a scale where this adds up to real money for editors who

consistently ship winners. The leaderboard isn't just for show — it's there so

the people putting in the work actually get rewarded for it.





------------------------------------------------------------

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

------------------------------------------------------------

  - You make pretty videos but don't understand direct response. If you can't

    explain why a hook works or what makes an ad convert, this isn't the role.



  - You need hand-holding. You'll get guidance and frameworks from our head

    editor, but you're expected to manage your own workload, hit deadlines, and

    solve problems without constant check-ins.



  - You're a one-tool specialist who resists learning new things. Our stack

    changes weekly. If a new AI tool drops and the team adopts it overnight, you

    need to pivot without frustration.



  - You see this as "just a job." The people who win here are genuinely into

    short-form, AI creative, and direct response — and want to grow with a

    fast-scaling brand, not clock in and out.



------------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

------------------------------------------------------------

In your proposal, include:

 - The Names of the previous Ecom Brands/Companies you have edited for

  - A short description of your current skillset.

  - A few examples of past ad creative work (UGC, voiceover, animation —

    whatever you've got) to back it up, including the DTC brand(s) you've worked

    with.



Then answer these questions:



  1. Pick one ad creative you've made that performed well. Break down WHY it

     worked from a direct-response angle — the hook, pacing, offer, CTA, or any

     specific editing choice that drove the result.

title: HR Generalist & Recruiter – Must Have Performance Marketing Agency Background
description:
About HypeTribe Asia

HypeTribe is a venture studio building and scaling D2C brands across health, wellness, and digital marketing.

We're AI-native, lean, and ship daily. We hire performance marketers, creatives, and operators across multiple time zones — and we need an HR partner who will work under one of the portfolio companies of Hypetribe and actually understands the talent we're recruiting.



Why this role is different

Most HR people don't know what a "media buyer" actually does, or how to spot a real prompt engineer vs. someone who just listed "AI" on their résumé. That's exactly why we're specifically looking for someone who has worked inside a performance marketing agency, growth agency, or D2C marketing team before. You've seen these roles up close. You know what a great media buyer looks like in an interview, how to vet a copywriter's portfolio.



If you've never sat next to a media buyer or watched a creative team brief out ad concepts, this role is not for you.



What you'll own



1. End-to-end recruitment for media buyers, copywriters, prompt engineers, creative strategists, video editors, ops roles, etc across multiple brands

2. Sourcing (OnlineJobs, LinkedIn, Upwork, referrals), screening calls, scorecards, interview coordination, reference checks

3. Negotiating and closing offers — comp, scope, start dates

4. HR admin: contracts, onboarding, time tracking, payroll coordination, performance check-ins, offboarding

5. General admin tasks supporting founders and managers — calendar coordination, document management, internal communications, ad-hoc operational support

6. Building and maintaining hiring SOPs, candidate pipelines, and ATS workflows (we systematize everything)

7. Compliance and documentation across multiple jurisdictions

8. Using AI daily to accelerate sourcing, screening, drafting JDs, summarizing interviews, and admin



You're a strong fit if you have



1. You have worked on a performance marketing agency, growth agency, or D2C marketing team — in HR, talent, ops, recruiting, or account management

2. Direct experience hiring or recruiting media buyers, copywriters, or creative talent

3. Strong negotiation skills — you can close candidates and push back on unreasonable asks

4. Deep comfort with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) — you use them every day, not just when it's convenient

5. Highly organized and proactive — you can run 10+ open roles across 4 brands without dropping a ball

6. Excellent written and spoken English

7. Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift weekly and you wear multiple hats



Bonus points



1. Experience hiring across international markets (US, EU, PH, LATAM)

2. Background in health & wellness, telehealth, or supplements

3. Experience writing or refining job descriptions that actually attract A-players

4. Graduated from one of the Philippines' top universities, including:



University of the Philippines (UP)

Ateneo de Manila University (ADMU)

De La Salle University (DLSU)

University of Santo Tomas (UST)



What we offer



1. Competitive salary, based on experience and what you bring

2. Long-term, full-time role with real growth — as we add brands, you build the team

3. Direct exposure to founders and the inner mechanics of a fast-scaling venture studio

4. AI tools, software, and training fully covered

5. A team that values speed, ownership, and intelligence.





HOW TO APPLY

In your message, answer these four questions (short, direct answers — no fluff):



1. Which performance marketing agency or D2C company have you worked at, and what was your role? Briefly describe what the company did and the talent you saw being hired.

2. Describe one media buyer, copywriter, or creative hire you were involved in. How did you evaluate them, and what made them a fit (or not)?

3. Which AI tools do you use weekly, and give one concrete example of how you used AI in your last role.

4. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP?

5. Include a 90-second Loom video introducing yourself.

6. Attach your CV.



Applications that don't follow this format will not be reviewed. Selected candidates will hear back within 5 business days.

title: Digital Marketing Coordinator (Content, Operations & Systems)
description:
About DCB Digital

We're a growing Queensland-based digital marketing agency working with professional services and trades businesses across Australia. We specialise in web design, SEO, paid ads, and social media, and we work with clients who are serious about getting results.

We're a small, focused team that cares about doing good work properly. Everyone here is across real client accounts from day one and expected to take ownership of their area without needing to be managed closely.



About the role

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator who wants to grow with us, not just fill a seat.

This is a broad role and that's intentional. You'll work directly alongside the Directors across content creation, social media, AI, automations, operations, systems, and client support. In the short term you'll also be across social media delivery as we transition away from that service. For the right person, that's an opportunity to get across every part of how a digital agency runs and build from there.

We use AI properly here. Not as a gimmick, but as a core part of how we work. We're building automations, running AI agents, and integrating AI tools across the agency as it grows. This person needs to be genuinely across that world, not just familiar with it.

We're not looking for someone who needs a lot of direction. We're looking for someone who spots what needs doing, does it well, and is always thinking about how to do it better.



How we work

We don't measure success by how many tasks got completed. We measure it by outcomes. Every piece of work we do has a reason behind it and we expect everyone on the team to understand that reason, not just execute the task.

If you're the kind of person who asks "what are we actually trying to achieve here" before diving in, you'll fit right in. If you'd rather just be told what to do and get it done, this probably isn't the right place for you.

We're always looking at how we can do things better, get stronger results for our clients, and improve how the agency runs. We want someone who thinks the same way, comes with ideas, and isn't satisfied with good enough.



What you'll be doing

Director and client support



Managing the Directors' inboxes and calendars

Scheduling meetings, managing deadlines, and protecting their time

Drafting and responding to
s on behalf of the Directors

Assisting with client communications and following up with clients as needed

Taking notes during client calls and sending follow-up summaries and next steps

Keeping communication moving so nothing gets missed



Social media, content creation and account growth



Designing graphics and social assets in Canva across multiple client brands

Basic graphic design work beyond Canva where required

Editing short-form video for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Stories using CapCut and AI-assisted tools

Writing captions suited to each client's tone and audience

Creating and managing content across LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok

Managing content calendars across multiple client accounts

Scheduling and publishing content across LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok via Later, Buffer, or Meta Business Suite

Growing client accounts and DCB Digital's own accounts through organic and paid strategies

Staying across platform trends on LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok and applying them quickly

Monitoring account performance and adjusting content strategy based on what the data shows

Optimising profiles, posting cadence, and engagement tactics to drive consistent growth

Managing client Slack channels and keeping communication organised

Pulling performance reports and flagging what needs attention

Responding to comments and DMs on client accounts as required



SEO, website and content support



Uploading and formatting blog posts and pages across client websites in WordPress

Assisting with content briefs and outlines during busy periods

Light editing of SEO content before it goes live

Resizing and compressing images for web use, with correct file naming and alt text

Preparing and optimising all assets before they go near a website

Quality checking websites before and after updates go live

Reviewing content for accuracy, formatting, and consistency before it reaches the client

Pulling reports from Google Search Console, GA4, and other platforms



AI and automations



Working daily with our AI stack including Claude, ChatGPT, Paperclip, and Hermes

Using Hermes as part of your daily workflow and helping build and manage it as the agency develops

Building and maintaining automations in 
 and Zapier from scratch

Helping integrate AI tools across agency workflows as we grow

Identifying where AI and automation can remove bottlenecks and flagging opportunities to the Directors

Keeping across new AI tools and developments and bringing relevant ones to the table



Operations, systems and research



Ensuring Zoho is updated daily across all active client accounts

Assisting with onboarding new clients and getting them set up correctly in Zoho

Keeping track of client deliverables and deadlines across the agency

Following up with the team to make sure work is on track and nothing is slipping

Chasing outstanding tasks and keeping the Directors informed of anything at risk

Organising and maintaining folder structures across all client accounts

Building and documenting processes and SOPs into a proper agency system

Supporting the broader DCB tech stack as it grows

Collecting data and conducting research for client reporting and new business

Competitor and market research across both client accounts and agency growth

Collating findings into clear, usable formats for the Directors

Ad hoc project support across the agency as needed



Basic bookkeeping support



Collecting and uploading receipts to Xero

Reconciling receipts and categorising expenses

Chasing missing receipts when flagged by our bookkeeper

Keeping the accounts clean between bookkeeper reports





Tools you'll need to know



Canva and basic graphic design

CapCut and AI video editing tools

Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok (content creation, management, and scheduling)

Later, Buffer, or Meta Business Suite

Claude, ChatGPT, Paperclip, and AI agent workflows


 and Zapier (building from scratch, not just maintaining)

Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)

WordPress

Slack

Zoho

ClickUp or similar project management tools

Xero (basic receipt and expense management)

Google Search Console and GA4





What we need from you



Proven experience working inside a digital marketing agency (non-negotiable)

Strong English, written and spoken, you'll be communicating with clients and on behalf of the Directors

Solid content creation skills across Canva, Instagram, and short-form video

Basic graphic design skills beyond Canva

Proven experience creating and managing content across LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok

Proven experience growing social media accounts organically and through paid activity

Someone who is genuinely across platform trends and knows how to use them, not just someone who follows them passively

Genuine hands-on experience building automations in 
 or Zapier from scratch

Real working knowledge of AI tools including Claude, ChatGPT, and AI agents, not just a passing familiarity

Comfortable working alongside and helping develop AI agents as part of daily operations

A solid understanding of SEO basics and how digital marketing agencies operate

Experience managing a busy inbox and calendar on behalf of someone else

Strong research skills and an ability to turn data into something useful

A sharp eye for quality, errors, and inconsistencies

A genuine drive to do things better, someone who brings initiative and fresh thinking rather than waiting to be told

Comfortable with Xero at a basic level

Highly organised with the kind of attention to detail that means things don't fall through the cracks

Someone who follows through without being chased and communicates proactively when something is off





What we offer



$9 to $12 USD per hour based on experience

Performance bonuses introduced from 60 days based on outcomes and results

Rate reviewed at 90 days

Long-term role with genuine growth potential

Direct access to and mentorship from the Directors

Exposure to a broad range of digital marketing disciplines

A front-row seat to how AI is changing agency work, and a real role in building it





Why this role is worth your time

You'll work directly with the Directors, be trusted with real client accounts from day one, and have a clear path to taking on more as the business grows. This isn't a role where you clock in, complete a task list, and disappear.

We're a growing agency that does good work and takes it seriously. The person who comes into this role and performs well will have more opportunity here than most agencies would offer. More responsibility, more involvement in where the business is going, and room to grow into a senior position over time.

If you're looking for somewhere to genuinely build a career in digital marketing, this is worth your time.



You'll thrive here if you



Can manage content for multiple brands and keep each one sounding like itself

Get excited when a trend drops and already know how to make it work for a brand

Are comfortable being trusted with a Director's inbox and client communications

Have actually built automations, not just switched them on

Know your way around AI tools and are genuinely curious about where they're going

Come with ideas, not just completed tasks

Are always looking for a better way to do something, not just the way it's always been done

Take pride in being genuinely good at what you do, not just getting it done

Pick up new tools quickly and don't need things explained twice

Spot problems before they're flagged and say something

Want to grow into something bigger, not just tick tasks off a list





This role is not for you if you



Need a lot of hand-holding or detailed daily instruction

Have only worked in-house or as a solo freelancer, never inside an agency

Think using AI means occasionally asking ChatGPT a question

Are happy to complete a task without understanding why it matters

Treat a job description as a strict list of tasks rather than a guide for what the business needs





To apply

Record a Loom video (5 minutes maximum) and include the link in your application. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

Your Loom must cover:



Introduce yourself and tell us about your experience working inside a digital marketing agency

Walk us through one automation you have built from scratch, what the problem was and what it solved

Show us an example of content you have created for a client and talk us through your thinking behind it

Tell us what AI tools you use every day and show us how you use at least one of them

Tell us why this role is the right next step for you



We're looking for clear, confident English, specific examples not general claims, and someone who gets genuinely excited talking about this work. Someone who can't be bothered recording a Loom won't progress to the next stage.

title: Full-time Short Form Editor
Remote Executive Admin & Finance (QuickBooks + AI Systems Support)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Are you a detail-oriented, systems-minded Virtual Professional who enjoys keeping financial records organized, building clean trackers, and turning messy information into clear workflows?



We are looking for a proactive Executive Admin & Finance Virtual Professional who can support finance, admin, operations, reporting, and process documentation. This role is ideal for someone who is accurate with numbers, comfortable with QuickBooks or similar accounting tools, and excited about using AI responsibly to make work clearer, faster, and better documented.



This is not just a task-support role. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems - someone who enjoys creating SOPs, checklists, trackers, dashboards, templates, and better ways of managing recurring work.



You may be a great fit if you like organizing details, catching inconsistencies, improving processes, and helping leadership stay financially informed and operationally prepared.



What You Will Do

You will support day-to-day finance, admin, reporting, documentation, and workflow improvement tasks.



Finance & Bookkeeping Support

• Track invoices, receipts, payments, payables, receivables, reimbursements, and vendor records.

• Support QuickBooks Online or similar accounting systems with organized data entry, categorization, and cleanup.

• Assist with bank and credit card reconciliation support.

• Help maintain clean records for transactions, vendors, invoices, and supporting documents.

• Prepare financial trackers, summaries, simple reports, and management updates.

• Organize PDFs, screenshots, receipts, invoices, and related files so records are easy to find and review.

• Spot missing information, duplicate entries, inconsistent categories, and reporting gaps before they become bigger issues.



Executive Admin & Operations Support

• Manage calendars, reminders, meetings, follow-ups, deadlines, and recurring priorities.

• Coordinate administrative details, project trackers, vendor information, forms, and documentation.

• Support research, file organization, task follow-through, and internal updates.

• Give clear progress updates, ask smart questions, and close communication loops.

• Handle sensitive business and administrative information with discretion and professionalism.



Systems, SOPs & AI-Assisted Workflow Support

• Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, trackers, dashboards, templates, and process documentation.

• Turn scattered notes, screenshots, recordings, inbox items, or financial details into clear action steps.

• Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar platforms to support summaries, research, documentation, first drafts, and workflow organization.

• Build simple prompt templates or AI-assisted workflows that make recurring tasks cleaner and faster.

• Review and verify AI output before sharing it.

• Protect confidential information and avoid relying on unchecked AI-generated answers.

• Recommend practical improvements when work is messy, manual, duplicated, or unclear.



Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is organized, accurate, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote setup. You should enjoy finance/admin work, but also be curious about systems, documentation, and smarter ways to get things done.



You may be a great fit if you:

• Have at least 2 years of experience in finance/admin, bookkeeping support, executive admin, operations, or a related role.

• Have hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online or a similar accounting platform such as Xero, FreshBooks, Zoho Books, NetSuite, or similar tools.

• Are comfortable handling invoice tracking, AP/AR support, vendor records, reconciliation support, reporting, or financial admin tasks.

• Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for trackers, formulas, organized data, and reporting.

• Are highly detail-oriented and careful with numbers, deadlines, and confidential information.

• Can write clear updates in English and communicate proactively.

• Naturally organize recurring work into checklists, templates, SOPs, trackers, or dashboards.

• Are comfortable using AI tools as a work partner for drafting, summarizing, organizing, researching, and improving documentation.

• Understand that AI output must still be checked, verified, and handled responsibly.

• Are resourceful, coachable, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision.



Preferred Experience: Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• QuickBooks Online cleanup, categorization, reconciliation support, or financial reporting.

• Accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice tracking, or vendor management.

• KPI dashboards, management reports, data cleanup, or reporting packs.

• SOP creation, Loom/process videos, workflow documentation, trackers, or process maps.

• Project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, 
, Trello, Notion, or Airtable.

• CRM tools, automation tools, Zapier, Make, or similar platforms.

• Supporting executives, operators, finance teams, or operations-heavy businesses.

• Coordinating applications, vendor setup, compliance research, permits, or project trackers.

• Using AI tools to improve admin, finance, reporting, documentation, or research workflows.



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements

To ensure a smooth and reliable remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 or higher preferred.

• Minimum 8GB RAM.

• Laptop or PC preferably less than 3 years old.

• Stable internet connection of at least 50-100 Mbps preferred.

• Backup internet connection.

• Quality webcam, microphone, and headset.

Screenshots of device specs and internet speed test may be requested during the application process.



You Will Thrive in This Role If...

• You enjoy bringing order to messy information.

• You like working with numbers, reports, trackers, records, and follow-ups.

• You often think, "There has to be a better system for this."

• You can follow instructions carefully but also think ahead.

• You ask thoughtful questions when information is missing.

• You give clear updates without needing to be chased.

• You enjoy creating checklists, documentation, templates, and better workflows.

• You use AI thoughtfully to improve work quality, not to replace judgment.

• You want a long-term remote role where reliability, ownership, communication, and continuous improvement matter.



This May Not Be the Best Fit If...

• You prefer task-by-task instructions and do not enjoy organizing ambiguity.

• You are uncomfortable with financial records, details, deadlines, or accuracy checks.

• You do not like documenting processes or creating trackers.

• You are not open to learning new systems or AI tools.

• You use AI as a shortcut without checking the output.

• You struggle with proactive communication or independent remote work.



Why You Will Love This Opportunity

• Full-time remote work.

• Weekends off.

• Paid holidays and PTO eligibility.

• HMO eligibility after the required tenure period.

• Family Medical Incentive eligibility.

• PAG-IBIG and referral incentives.

• Learning sessions and growth opportunities.

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community.

• Opportunity to strengthen finance, admin, systems, documentation, and AI workflow skills.



How to Apply: Please submit:

• Your updated resume.

• Your answers to the application questions below.



Application Questions

1. Tell us about your finance, bookkeeping support, executive admin, or operations experience. Which tools have you used?

2. Walk us through how you would reconcile a bank or credit card account in QuickBooks Online, or how you would clean up a messy invoice/payment tracker.

3. Which AI tools have you used at work? Share one specific example of how you used AI to organize information, save time, improve documentation, or create a better workflow. How did you check the output for accuracy?

Applications with clear, specific answers will be prioritized. We are especially interested in candidates who can show real examples of finance/admin accuracy, systems thinking, responsible AI use, and proactive communication.



Apply today and build a meaningful remote career where your accuracy, initiative, and systems mindset can truly shine.

title: Structural Engineer
description:
Role Summary

Department: Structural Engineering

Location: Remote - Philippines

About REMBOX

REMBOX is an international architecture, engineering, and BIM services company with over 650 professionals across Israel, Europe, and North America. We partner with leading architectural firms, engineering consultancies, project managers, and construction companies, providing architectural, structural, and BIM services for projects in Israel and the United States. Our portfolio includes residential complexes, high-rise towers, public buildings, office developments, industrial facilities, and large-scale infrastructure projects. Strong professional ethics and attention to quality

Ability to work effectively in a remote team environment

Willingness to learn and continuously develop professional skills

Strong communication and teamwork abilities

Experience with Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD

Ensure compliance with project standards, quality requirements, and delivery deadlines.

Establish and maintain BIM modeling standards and documentation templates.

Minimum Requirements:



Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering.

Advanced structural engineering knowledge and technical expertise.

Strong Autodesk Revit expertise, including template setup, standards management, and large federated model coordination.

Experience reviewing and leading project documentation and deliverables.

Excellent communication abilities (written and verbal) in an international team environment.

What REMBOX Offers

Full-time remote employment.

Long-term career opportunities within a growing international company.

Participation in large-scale international projects in Israel and the United States.

Professional mentoring and development programs.

BIM, software, and technical training.

Clear career growth path: Junior to Medior to Senior.

Collaborative, people-centered work culture.

International team of 650+ professionals.

Onboarding & Employment Structure

During the first months, candidates will work as independent contractors under a formal agreement with REMBOX's Israeli company. Interested candidates will go through the following recruitment process:

Initial interview: background, experience, and technical fit assessment.

Interview with REMBOX HR Manager: profile, expectations, and company discussion.

Technical interview with a Professional Team Leader from the structural discipline.

title: Customer Service Manager — Subscription / Recurring-Revenue Brand
description:
Hello Future Employee,

Who are we?



We're a fast-growing e-commerce company running Shopify brand stores across the USA and beyond, generating consistent 6-figure monthly revenue. We specialize in emotionally-driven direct response advertising. This role is for one of our subscription / recurring-revenue brands — a store with a sensitive, emotionally-driven customer base, where genuinely caring, empathetic customer service matters.

We're hiring a Backend Manager to bring structure, systems, and accountability to the backend of this brand. The right person is a builder — someone who walks into a fast-moving operation, finds what's broken or unorganized, and installs the SOPs, dashboards, and processes that make the machine run. You'll report directly to the founder and own this brand's backend end to end.

Because this is a recurring-revenue business, two things sit at the heart of the role: subscription operations and disputes/chargebacks. If you've run backend for a subscription brand and know how to keep chargeback ratios under control, this is for you.

Responsibilities:

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Management System & Document Control

- The Systems Administrator coordinates the day-to-day management of the company’s Document Register, ensuring that controlled documentation is regularly updated and maintained to the business's quality standards. In coordination with the Business Improvement Manager and departmental Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), this covers tracking review timelines, managing version control, aligning corporate branding across manuals and flowcharts, and the routine archiving needed to minimise process drift and keep client’s operational framework current.



2. Training & Platform Documentation Governance

- The Systems Administrator coordinates the alignment of controlled operational documentation with internal learning platforms, ensuring that training resources accurately reflect established business processes. In coordination with the Business Improvement Manager and training representatives, this covers cross-referencing standard operating workflows with published training materials (such as Trainual) and maintaining active, embedded document links across systems. The role handles routine document proofreading and verification checks, helping to streamline the verification pipeline before formal publication approvals are sought. 



3. Audit and Compliance Support

- This role assists with the administrative requirements of the internal audit schedule and compliance tracking, ensuring that reviews remain organised and well-supported. In coordination with the Business Improvement Manager, this covers compiling audit completion reports, and managing logistics for reviews. The role handles the timely logging of incoming Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and coordinates regular follow-ups with departmental action owners to track outstanding items, escalating stalled actions to the BI Manager when needed to keep workflows moving forward.



4. Feedback Tracking

- This role administers the internal suggestion and feedback loop process, ensuring that employee-driven ideas and system observations are systematically processed and reviewed. In coordination with the Business Improvement Manager, this covers triaging incoming feedback, logging items into the appropriate registers, and routing them to the correct departmental stakeholders for evaluation. The role handles regular follow-ups to track outcomes, helping to maintain a transparent and active continuous improvement pipeline across the business. 



5. KPI Data Collection & Reporting Assistance

- This role maintains the administrative collection and compilation of compliance and performance data across various departments to meet BI reporting milestones. In coordination with the Business Improvement Manager, this covers gathering, collating, and validating operational data inputs to ensure they are clean, complete, and readily accessible. The role provides routine assistance in formatting monthly and quarterly KPI summaries, helping to prepare clear data packages for leadership review routines.



QUALIFICATIONS:

Technical Skills and Experience

- Exceptional organisational capability with attention to detail and precision. 

- Demonstrated experience in document control, data entry and managing a filing system, or a structured administrative compliance role. 

- High level of proficiency within Google Workspace or equivalent cloud-based productivity suites. 

- Demonstrated communication skills, specifically with the proven ability to articulate problems and confidently follow up on outstanding actions.

- Strong written skills, including attention to detail, with experience executing document proofreading and verification checks, ensuring materials align with corporate standards. 

- Familiarity with management system principles, compliance frameworks (such as ISO 9001), or continuous improvement cycles (PDCA). 

- Familiarity with graphic design principles or document layout formatting, helping to ensure corporate documents, flowcharts, and forms are visually clear and aligned with brand guidelines. 

- Previous experience in construction, engineering, or a technically regulated industry environment is advantageous, along with exposure to platforms like Procore, Trainual, or Smartsheet.



Personal Attributes

- An inquiring, logic-driven mind that finds genuine satisfaction in bringing order to complexity.

- Ability to work autonomously, manage competing administrative priorities, and maintain registers and tracking systems. 

- Collaborative and confident communication style to follow up on outstanding tasks and compliance data with busy operational teams across the business. 

- Collaborative by instinct and persistent by habit, with a genuine motivation to improve how the business operates day-to-day.



At Boundless Collective, we take pride in fostering a culture of confidence, reliability, and a relentless commitment to excellence. If you are ready to support a dynamic executive team and grow in a supportive environment, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior AEO / GEO / AI Search Optimization Specialist
description:
Trillet is looking for a senior AEO / GEO / AI search optimization specialist to help us build search visibility for the AI-search era.



This role is for someone who understands modern SEO beyond traditional rankings: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, entity SEO, semantic SEO, structured data, topical authority, internal linking, crawl/indexation health, and technical SEO foundations.



We are especially interested in candidates who can own both strategy and hands-on execution.



Responsibilities may include:

- Audit our current site and content for technical SEO, schema, entity coverage, crawlability, internal linking, and AI-search visibility.

- Build an AEO/GEO roadmap for Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI discovery surfaces.

- Recommend and implement structured data, answer-first content structures, entity/topic maps, and internal linking systems.

- Work with our team to turn product and customer knowledge into high-authority content that can rank, be cited, and convert.

- Track performance using tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, RankMath/Yoast, schema validators, and AI-search visibility workflows.

- Write clear strategy notes, implementation instructions, and async updates.



Strong candidates will have:

- Proven SEO experience with real AEO, GEO, AI-search, semantic SEO, entity SEO, technical SEO, or structured-data work.

- Evidence of outcomes from campaigns they personally drove.

- Strong written English and comfort explaining strategy clearly.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize high-impact work, and be honest about what is proven versus experimental.

- Availability for a long-term role. We are open to full-time or strong part-time specialists.



When applying, please include:

1. Your current availability and preferred working hours.

2. Your expected monthly compensation in USD.

3. Your English level and whether you are comfortable owning written strategy docs and async updates.

4. 2-3 concrete AEO/GEO/AI-search or technical SEO wins you personally drove, with the site/category, actions taken, and measurable outcome.

5. The tools you use for technical SEO, schema/entity optimization, GSC/GA4, and AI-search visibility tracking.

6. Whether you prefer strategy, content, technical implementation, or owning the full AEO/GEO function.

title: Amazon Creative Graphic Designer and Video Editor
description:
Position: Amazon Creative Graphic Designer and Video Editor



Type: Part-Time / Project-Based, Remote

Compensation: Part-time or project-based rate depending on portfolio quality, direct Amazon private label creative experience, video editing ability, and workload. Full-time equivalent range: PHP 25,000 - 60,000/month.





About Us



We are a Canadian company building Amazon FBA private label and wholesale operations in the United States and Canada. We are looking for an Amazon private label creative designer who can support product launches with strong Amazon listing images, A+ Content, packaging visuals, product inserts, mockups, videos, and other launch-related creatives.



This is not a general graphic design role. We need someone with direct Amazon private label creative experience.





Experience Level Required



We are looking for an intermediate to senior-level creative designer with 2+ years of direct Amazon private label creative design experience.



Candidates should already understand Amazon listing image structure, product infographics, A+ Content, comparison charts, feature/benefit visuals, product image editing, packaging visuals, and conversion-focused Amazon product presentation.





Portfolio Required



Applications with relevant Amazon listing image, A+ Content, product image, packaging, ad creative, or product video samples are preferred.





Role Overview



You will help create end-to-end creative assets for Amazon FBA private label product launches. The work may include listing image sets, product infographics, A+ Content, product mockups, packaging visuals, inserts, short product videos, ad creatives, and other Amazon launch-related assets.



The main goal is to make physical products look clear, premium, trustworthy, and conversion-focused on Amazon.





Key Responsibilities



• Design complete Amazon listing image sets, including main image concepts, secondary images, benefit images, product-in-use visuals, bundle visuals, and comparison graphics.

• Create product infographics showing features, dimensions, materials, benefits, use cases, bundle contents, and customer pain-point solutions.

• Design A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content, brand story visuals, comparison modules, and product education graphics.

• Create packaging concepts, box mockups, labels, inserts, thank-you cards, instruction cards, and other printed assets.

• Edit supplier images, sample photos, product photos, lifestyle images, and raw product visuals for Amazon use.

• Create or edit short product videos, product demo videos, listing videos, ad-style videos, and launch creatives when needed.

• Create ad creatives, promo graphics, storefront visuals, banners, icons, badges, and other Amazon brand assets.

• Use AI tools when useful for creative ideation, mockups, image support, video support, and workflow speed, while checking quality and accuracy.

• Keep creative files, source files, exports, versions, and references organized in Google Drive.

• Communicate clearly about completed work, design notes, missing assets, blockers, revisions, and next steps.





Requirements



• 2+ years of direct Amazon creative design experience required, including Amazon listing images, product infographics, A+ Content, product image editing, comparison charts, packaging visuals, inserts, product mockups, and/or Amazon product videos.

• Intermediate to senior-level design ability required.

• Strong portfolio required.

• Strong static design ability required.

• Basic-to-intermediate video editing ability strongly preferred.

• Experience with tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, AI image/video tools, or similar tools.

• Good understanding of Amazon product presentation, listing image structure, layout, typography, image clarity, visual hierarchy, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to create clean, professional, premium-looking visuals for physical products.

• Strong attention to detail with spelling, product claims, dimensions, packaging text, image sizes, file formats, and revisions.

• Organized, reliable, responsive, and comfortable working independently.





Not Suitable For



This role is not suitable for candidates whose experience is mainly general VA work, customer service, basic Canva templates, logo-only design, or social-media-only graphics. We are looking for someone with Amazon private label product creative ability.





How to Apply



To apply, start your message with:



“Amazon Creative Designer”



Then include:



1. Your portfolio link

2. Your direct Amazon creative experience

3. Your experience with listing images, infographics, A+ Content, packaging, inserts, mockups, and video

4. The tools you use

5. Your expected rate

6. Your availability and earliest start date

Build and maintain workflows in n8n (and/or

title: Book Production Virtual Assistant – Writing, Publishing, Audiobook & Content Support
description:
I am seeking a highly organized and experienced Book Production Virtual Assistant to support the full book writing, publishing, audiobook, and content development process.



This is not a general admin VA role. I am looking for someone who understands how to help turn raw ideas, notes, voice recordings, outlines, transcripts, and rough drafts into organized book content, publishable manuscripts, audiobooks, and related digital content assets.



The role will support projects such as devotionals, faith-based books, memoir/personal testimony, leadership content, business books, AI/risk/governance content, workbooks, study guides, audiobooks, and digital products.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Book Planning and Organization



* Organize book ideas, chapter outlines, themes, and writing schedules

* Convert rough notes, transcripts, and voice recordings into structured chapter outlines

* Track manuscript progress, revisions, deadlines, and publishing milestones

* Help create a clear book development roadmap from idea to publication



2. Research and Content Support



* Conduct research to support book topics, scripture references, examples, audience needs, and comparable books

* Organize research notes and sources clearly

* Identify content gaps and suggest ways to improve structure and flow



3. Drafting and Manuscript Support



* Help clean up rough drafts, transcripts, and notes into readable book sections

* Improve grammar, clarity, organization, and flow while preserving the author’s voice

* Support devotional, memoir, leadership, business, and instructional writing projects



4. Editing and Quality Control



* Review chapters for grammar, consistency, formatting, flow, and readability

* Track revisions and manage manuscript versions

* Help coordinate with editors, designers, audiobook producers, or publishing support vendors if needed



5. Publishing Preparation



* Assist with Amazon KDP, Kindle, paperback, ebook, and PDF preparation

* Help organize front matter, back matter, author bio, book description, acknowledgments, copyright page, keywords, categories, and launch checklists



6. Audiobook and Voice-Cloning Support



* Prepare chapters for audiobook narration

* Convert manuscript chapters into clean audio-ready scripts

* Support authorized AI narration or voice-cloning workflows

* Review audio for clarity, pacing, pronunciation, tone, and consistency

* Organize audio files by chapter, section, and version

* Help repurpose audio content for YouTube, podcasts, devotionals, courses, or digital products



Voice cloning must only be used ethically and with proper authorization. No voice may be cloned, copied, imitated, uploaded, or used without approval and consent.



7. Content Repurposing



* Turn book chapters into social media posts, newsletters, devotionals, YouTube scripts, short video scripts, podcast scripts, workbook questions, reflection questions, and downloadable resources

* Help create content that supports book launches, audience growth, and digital product development



8. Project Management



* Maintain clear project trackers

* Organize files in Google Drive or similar platforms

* Use proper file naming and version control

* Provide regular progress updates

* Communicate blockers early and clearly



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Prior experience supporting book writing, publishing, ghostwriting, editing, or author assistance

* Strong English writing, editing, grammar, and organization skills

* Experience working with manuscripts, long-form content, or book projects

* Ability to preserve the author’s voice while improving structure and clarity

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

* Experience with Google Docs, Microsoft Word, Google Drive, and basic file organization

* Comfortable working with faith-based, personal development, leadership, business, and educational content



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



* Amazon KDP or self-publishing experience

* Audiobook production or AI narration experience

* Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grammarly, Canva, Notion, Trello, ClickUp, ElevenLabs, Descript, PlayHT, Speechify, Audacity, or similar tools

* Experience repurposing books into courses, newsletters, social media content, YouTube scripts, or digital products

* Experience supporting devotionals, memoirs, nonfiction books, leadership books, or business books



CONFIDENTIALITY AND AI USE



All manuscripts, notes, recordings, drafts, ideas, and business concepts are confidential. All work created for this role belongs to the author/company.



The VA may not reuse, share, publish, distribute, or place any content into a portfolio without written permission.



AI tools may only be used with approval. Confidential manuscript content, voice samples, personal stories, or unpublished materials must not be uploaded into third-party AI tools without permission.



WORK SCHEDULE



This is a part-time, project-based remote role with potential for long-term collaboration. Initial workload may start at approximately 5–10 hours per week and may increase depending on the stage of the project.



Occasional availability between 6:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time is preferred for project check-ins.



COMPENSATION



Please include your hourly rate or project-based pricing in your application. Compensation will be based on experience, quality of work, and demonstrated ability to support book production, publishing, audiobook preparation, and content repurposing.



A small paid trial project may be required before long-term work begins.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the phrase “Book VA Specialist” in your application so I know you read the full job description.



In your response, please provide:



1. A brief summary of your book writing, editing, publishing, or author support experience

2. Examples of book-related projects you have worked on

3. Your experience with Amazon KDP, manuscript organization, editing, formatting, or publishing preparation

4. Your experience with audiobook production, AI narration, text-to-speech, or ethical voice cloning

5. The tools you are comfortable using

6. Your hourly rate or project-based fee

7. Your weekly availability and preferred working schedule

8. A brief explanation of how you would help organize a book project from idea to publication



SCREENING QUESTIONS



1. Describe the exact steps you would take to turn 20 pages of rough notes and voice transcripts into a polished book chapter.



2. How would you preserve an author’s voice while improving grammar, clarity, and structure?



3. What is your experience with audiobook production, AI narration, or voice-cloning tools?

title: Market Research / Lead gen
description:
Hey!



I'm looking for someone to help me with the first stage of a business research project.



The goal is simple: identify one business niche with a recurring operational problem that's genuinely worth investigating.



You can choose any industry you want, as long as it meets these criteria:

• Businesses already spend money trying to solve the problem.

• Decision-makers are easy to reach through LinkedIn or
.

• There is a recurring problem tied to time, money, or risk.

• The problem is common enough that businesses are already dealing with it somehow.

• It isn't in the adult or gambling industry.



Your responsibilities will include:

• Find one promising business niche that meets the project requirements.

• Narrow that niche down to a specific target customer.

• Research how businesses in that niche typically operate.

• Form a hypothesis about one recurring operational problem worth investigating.

• Generate a qualified lead list of 50–70 businesses that match your chosen ICP.



By the end of the project, I’d like to receive a PDF handoff document for the interviewer to start their outreach. It should contain: 

• A clearly defined niche.

• A clearly defined Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

• A summary of how businesses in that niche typically operate.

• Existing solutions and competitors.

• A clearly reasoned operational problem that you believe is worth validating.

• A spreadsheet containing the lead list.



I'm looking for someone who can think critically, connect different pieces of information, and justify why a particular opportunity is worth investigating.



AI is completely fine to use for brainstorming, organizing notes, and speeding up research. Just don't rely on it as evidence. Everything you conclude should be supported by sources you've verified yourself.



The project pays €175 and is expected to take about seven days.



To apply, please tell me the following:

• A short introduction about yourself.

• Previous experience, if applicable.

• How you would approach this project during the first few days.



Don't overthink the application or make it sound overly corporate. Just write how you normally would. Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Research Analyst

• Determining whether the original hypothesis is supported, should be revised, or should be rejected.

title: Brand Ambassador & Outreach Assistant
description:
J Squared Candle Co. is a hand-poured soy wax candle and home fragrance business based in Columbus, Ohio. We are a small, family-run brand with a big heart and a growing presence across retail markets, wholesale accounts, and online channels. We are passionate about what we do and we are looking for someone who shares that energy. If you love supporting small businesses and want to grow alongside a brand that is just getting started, this might be the perfect fit for you.



**THREE CORE FOCUS AREAS**

1. Corporate Gifting — Reach companies looking for employee, client, and holiday gifts

2. Wholesale — Connect with boutiques, shops, and retailers who may carry our products

3. Fundraising — Partner with schools, nonprofits, and organizations on fundraiser programs



**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

- Research and identify leads across our three focus areas: corporate gifting, wholesale, and fundraising partnerships

- Reach out to leads via LinkedIn,
, Instagram, or TikTok, whichever channel makes the most sense for each target. We need someone who is comfortable across all platforms and can pivot as needed

- Follow up consistently and professionally on all unanswered outreach at scheduled intervals

- Update and maintain our product inventory in our backend inventory tool (Inventora) on a weekly basis

- Assist with seasonal inventory and listing updates across our selling platforms (Faire, website, etc.) when new products launch

- Help with miscellaneous tasks as needed, which may include light admin work, spreadsheet tracking, or other support that helps the business run smoothly

- Grow with us. As J Squared grows, we expect this role to grow too, with more hours, expanded responsibilities, and the opportunity to take on a bigger role in our operations



**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

Skills and tools matter, but character matters more to us. Here is who we are hoping to find:



- Reliable and responsible. You do what you say you will do and you communicate when something comes up.

- Friendly and professional. You can write a warm, genuine message that does not sound like a template, even when it is.

- Adaptable and a self-starter. You can figure out the right approach for each platform or lead type without needing step-by-step instructions every time.

- Confident but humble. You bring ideas and take initiative, but you are also open to feedback and focused on doing good work over looking good.

- Passionate about small business. You genuinely enjoy helping a growing brand succeed, not just completing tasks.

- Someone who tries their best. We are not looking for perfection. We are looking for effort, consistency, and someone who takes pride in their work.



**HOURS, PAY, AND PERKS**

This is a part-time role, approximately 4 hours per week at $4.50/hr (USD), paid monthly via PayPal or Wise. As a small business that is actively growing, we see this as a long-term relationship. Tea
mbers who grow with us and contribute to our success will be recognized for it, including the potential for a year-end performance bonus. We want this to be a role you are proud to be part of.



**TO APPLY**

Please send a short message introducing yourself, your experience with outreach or social media, and a brief sample of how you would reach out to a local boutique about carrying our candles. We read every application carefully. To show us you have read this posting in full, please begin your message with the phrase "I love candles." Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

title: Full-Time Finance & Operations Analyst (Remote)
description:
Full-Time Finance & Operations Analyst (Remote) — Own Our Numbers

Company: BuiltWell Group — property rehabs, turns & renovations (US) Type: Full-time · Remote · Long-term Languages: English and Spanish (both required)







We're looking for one exceptional person to own our numbers end-to-end. We rehab properties and move fast — and we need someone who always knows exactly where our money is: the profit on every property, what we're spending on materials and labor as a job evolves, what's owed vs. collected, and how our investors' money is doing.



This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role reporting straight to the founder. Do it well and you grow into running our whole financial operation.

What you'll do

Track gross profit on every property — live, from day one to close. Know material and labor spend in the first few days, then keep it updated as the job moves.

Relentlessly chase missing data from subs, project managers, VAs, and clients (in English and Spanish) until every number is in. This is the heart of the job.

Run payroll and manage investor portfolio accounts (track, reconcile, report — you don't make investment decisions).

Produce clean profit and investor reports on our 15th/30th pay cadence.

Work hand-in-hand with our accountant so your numbers always tie out to the books.

Improve our in-house apps when needed — small, careful edits to our web tools (HTML/CSS/JavaScript) and Supabase database, always with founder approval.

You must have

Relentless follow-up — you don't stop until the number is in. (Our #1 trait.)

Fluent English AND Spanish, written and spoken.

Strong with numbers/money — gross profit, margins, billed vs. collected, reconciliation, payroll.

Basic coding — comfortable editing HTML/CSS/JavaScript and a Supabase/Postgres database without breaking anything. (Not a senior engineer — just careful and capable.)

Spreadsheet fluency (Excel/Sheets), obsessive accuracy, and total trustworthiness with money (references + background check).



Nice to have: real estate/construction, accounting/payroll (QuickBooks, Gusto), investor reporting experience.

How to apply — do all 4 or you'll be skipped

A 2–3 min video: "A sub won't send a price we need to close out a property's profit, and the PM keeps saying 'I'll get it.' What do you do over the next 48 hours?"

A spreadsheet you built that calculates profit from a few line items (show your formulas).

Proof you can code a little — a link to anything you've built/edited, or a short screen recording of you changing a value in a simple HTML page.

One line: the most relentless thing you've ever done to get something across the finish line.



Subject line: I own the numbers — [your name]



Applications without all four are not reviewed. We're hiring for relentlessness and accuracy over résumés.

title: Guest Experience Specialist, Third Coast Elevated Stays
description:
Third Coast Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving the Texas coast markets of Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island. We are focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes the Texas coast special - its people, coastal culture, beach communities, and local character - while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS + guest inbox), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), RingCentral (calls/SMS).



Our Elevated Promises

Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



1. Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review. 

We believe vacations are special—something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



2. Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in these markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



3. Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals – maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.?



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist - Texas Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Third Coast, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. You will manage guest messaging and calls, coordinate workorders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring elevated hospitality and experiences to every stay.



You will own:

• Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

• Guest messaging and phone communication

• Workorder coordination and task follow-through

• Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

We provide live coverage from 7:00am to 11:00pm Central Time (CDT). You will be assigned a consistent shift. On-call after-hour coverage (11:00pm-7:00am CDT) is handled by a separate rotation.



Central Daylight Time (CDT) ? Philippines Time (PHT):

• 7am–3pm CDT ? 8pm–4am PHT

• 11am–7pm CDT ? 12am–8am PHT

• 3pm–11pm CDT ? 4am–12pm PHT

• 11pm–7am CDT ? 12pm–8pm PHT



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $800 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

• 13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)

• Monthly 5-Star Bonus: $50 if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 60%+.

• PTO: Accrues at 1 paid days per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines. 



Role and Responsibilities



Elevated Guest Engagement (Guesty + text/email)

• Answer guest messages (text,
, OTA inbox via Guesty) with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

• Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/roads, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

• Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

• Ensure every guest experience feels special and elevated



Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

• Place a welcome phone call to every guest prior to arrival day and send a personalized welcome text

• Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

• Identify opportunities to make the guest’s stay an elevated and memorable experience



Phone support (RingCentral)

• Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

• Troubleshoot common issues (access, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics) and escalate when needed



Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

• Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

• Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

• Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless



Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

• Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

• Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner by 6:00pm CDT the night prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

• Maintain accurate property notes and updates

• Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context



Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

• Guest messages answered within 15 minutes during your shift (text,
, Guesty inbox)

• Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

• No open guest messages left at shift end; clean handoffs with clear notes

• Workorders created promptly and vendor/team acknowledgment confirmed quickly



Property Listing Management & OTA Updates

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, and other OTAs.

• Update photos, amenities, room configurations, access notes, and seasonal details as needed.

• Ensure descriptions reflect the true guest experience with clear, warm, and helpful language.

• Flag inconsistencies, outdated information, or missing details to the Manager for correction.

• Support seasonal updates (spring break, summer beach season, hurricane season, local events, and holiday periods) to elevate guest expectations and reduce pre-arrival questions.

• Ensure every listing reflects our Elevated Promises — clarity, care, and a welcoming tone.



Local expertise

• Become an expert on Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island, including seasonal rhythms, beach conditions, weather impacts, and local norms.

• Learn the best restaurants, cafes, shops, beach activities, family experiences, fishing and boating options, and local attractions in each market so you can offer personalized, concierge-level recommendations that elevate each stay.

• Know our homes in detail: complete Matterport and photo walkthroughs; learn layouts, bedding, amenities, quirks, parking, access instructions, and any “good to know” details for guests.

• Stay current on local events and updates by checking event calendars, tourism sites, and community pages (including relevant local
 groups).

• Use your local and property knowledge proactively to help guests plan better stays, avoid common issues, and feel confidently looked after from booking to checkout.



What we look for

• Excellent written and spoken English and a warm, helpful tone

• Hospitality mindset (you enjoy caring for people, not just closing tickets)

• Strong ownership and follow-through, especially on weekends and busy days

• Detail-oriented and eager to learn homes, markets, and local context

• Comfortable learning and working inside Guesty, Breezeway, and RingCentral

• Reliable internet and a quiet, professional work environment



How to apply



Please submit the following:

• Resume/CV

• 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and your experience (English)

• Speedtest.net result (screenshot)



Short written samples: How would you respond to the following guest messages?

• “The hot tub isn’t heating. Can you help?”

• “Can we request a late checkout tomorrow?”

• “We’re staying in Port Aransas — any recommendations for a great breakfast spot for our family?”



Short written samples: These three guests message you at the same time. In what order would you respond and why?

• “We can’t get into the home, the code isn’t working.”

• “The Wi-Fi is slow and we need it for work.”

• “Can we check out one hour later?”

If you get a little thrill from figuring out a new tool, automating something tedious, and making a process better than you found it, you'll fit right in.

The AI, automation, and efficiency side is the core of what we're hiring for — but you'll also help with customer service for our clean Christian music app, a bit of marketing, and general admin, and you need to be genuinely open to pitching in wherever the team needs you. We use tools like Claude (and Claude Code) every day. You don't need to have done this before — but you do need to be excited to learn it.



If you anticipate what's needed before being asked, take real ownership, communicate like a pro, and love learning something new — keep reading.



We're hiring the person, not the résumé. Technical curiosity and drive matter most; the rest we can teach — including how we build with AI.



What you'll do



Build, automate, and make us more efficient with AI — use Claude / ChatGPT (and grow into Claude Code) to automate repetitive work, build simple internal tools, draft content, and find smarter, faster ways for the team to operate. This is the core of the role. We'll teach you; you bring the curiosity.
