title: Virtual Assistant (Social Media / Administrative / Graphic Design)
description:
The Role

We are looking for a true all-rounder — someone equally strong in design and operations. This is not a task-executor role. We need someone who thinks, takes initiative, and can work independently with minimal hand-holding. You will be one of the most important people in building this brand from zero.



The creator handles filming, brand decisions, approvals, posting, and deal negotiations. You handle everything else.



Role overview

Title Virtual Assistant — Travel Creator Brand

Hours 20–25 hours per week average. May increase during time-sensitive sprints.

Rate $5 USD per hour to start. Performance bonuses available for exceptional work and results.

Schedule Flexible hours — but Monday 9am EST handoff package is non-negotiable every week.

Communication Async preferred. Google Drive for files.
 for outreach. Weekly check-in call.

Start date Immediate

Tools provided Claude Pro membership · Google Workspace · Canva Pro access



What You Will Do

Your work falls into four categories. You must be genuinely capable in all four — not just one or two.



1 — Design & Creative

Brand board Build the full brand board from research: colour palette, typography, logo direction, mood board.

Content templates Design reusable carousel templates, Reel cover frames, and infographic layouts in Canva.

Mockups Create content mockups using existing photos and videos provided by the creator.

Visual consistency Ensure every piece of content looks and feels like Adventure Luxury Leisure — nothing generic, nothing templated.

Logo concept Design a circular avatar logo with globe, ALL acronym, and full brand name in the approved palette.

2 — Content Operations

Market research Research established and emerging creators across IG, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube. Identify gaps and opportunities.

Shoot briefs Write detailed briefs for every approved post: scripted hook, talking points, B-roll list, on-screen text, audio note, CTA.

Content ideas Submit 10 content ideas every Monday by 9am in a standard format.

Caption writing Draft platform-specific captions for IG, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube from each piece of content.

Hashtag & keyword research Build and maintain a 50-tag hashtag bank. Separate keyword lists for Pinterest and YouTube.

Scheduling Set up and manage Hootsuite or Buffer. Schedule content across all four platforms with optimised posting times.

Performance logging Log post performance within 24 hours. Flag anything performing 50%+ above or below average.

3 — Outreach & Pitching

UGC pitching Research and pitch travel brands, fashion brands, beauty brands, adventure gear brands, and baby travel gear brands for UGC partnerships.

Hotel pipeline Maintain a live pipeline of 5–10 hotels in active pitching at all times. Research, write, send, and follow up on all hotel pitches.

Platform applications Apply to UGC platforms: Billo, JoinBrands, 
, Cohley. Monitor for new campaigns weekly.

 management Send and receive all outreach from 
 any positive responses immediately.

4 — Systems & AI

Claude workflow Use Claude Pro as your primary drafting tool for briefs, captions, research summaries, pitch copy, and content ideas.

Prompt templates Build a standing Claude prompt that turns one piece of raw content into four platform-specific caption variations ready to schedule.

Editing Edit short-form video content using CapCut. Add captions using VEED. Brand all content to the approved visual identity.

Monthly reporting Deliver a monthly performance report: top posts, follower growth, pipeline summaries, and a one-paragraph assessment of what to adjust.



When to Stop and Flag

These situations require the creator's decision immediately. Do not proceed alone on any of the following.



Escalate immediately — within the hour

Brand deal inbound Any brand reaches out about a paid partnership of any kind.

Hotel responds positively Forward immediately. The creator closes the deal — you do not negotiate.

Post 50%+ below average Flag with data and a hypothesis within 48 hours.

Privacy concerns Any content involving the creator's son that feels uncomfortable or crosses a privacy line.

New competitor Any creator gaining traction in adventure-luxury-leisure or traveling mom + luxury positioning.



What We Are Looking For



Required skills and qualities

Canva Expert level. You build beautiful, brand-consistent visuals independently — not templated, not generic.

CapCut Comfortable editing short-form video content for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

Written English Excellent. All outreach, briefs, captions, and reports are drafted by you. Clear, professional, and on-brand.

AI tools You actively use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools in your daily workflow. Not occasionally — daily.

Research You can find the right hotel contact, the right brand campaign manager, the right hashtag set — independently.

Self-managing Monday handoff is a commitment, not a suggestion. Deadlines are met without reminders.

Detail-oriented Shoot briefs need to be exact. Pitch copy needs to be personalised. Close enough is not good enough.

Genuine interest in travel This brand lives and breathes adventure, luxury, and leisure. You need to get it instinctively.

Discretion You will have visibility of business finances, brand deals, and personal family content. Confidentiality always.



Nice to have — not required

UGC industry experience Have you worked with UGC platforms or pitched brands on a creator's behalf before?

Hotel or brand partnership experience Have you managed a pitch pipeline or outreach campaign before?

Hootsuite or Buffer Experience scheduling content across multiple platforms simultaneously.

Pinterest and YouTube SEO Understanding that these platforms are search engines first — keywords over hashtags.



Who Will Thrive in This Role

• You take initiative. You bring ideas, flag problems early, and find solutions without being asked.

• You use AI as a daily tool — not a novelty. Claude Pro is provided and expected to be used constantly.

• You have genuine taste. You know the difference between content that looks expensive and content that looks templated.

• You are organised and consistent. The creator should rarely have to chase you — you stay ahead.

• You care about the outcome, not just the task. The success of this brand matters to you.

• You are excited about the travel space. You find yourself watching luxury travel content because you love it, not just for research.



Compensation & Growth

Pay and benefits

Starting rate $5 USD per hour

Hours 20–25 hours per week average. Additional hours available during time-sensitive sprints.

Performance bonuses Available for exceptional work, strong UGC deal results, and successful hotel pipeline outcomes. Specifics discussed at offer stage.

Tools provided Claude Pro membership, Google Workspace access, Canva Pro access — all provided at no cost to you.

Growth This brand is building from zero with a clear path to significant revenue. The right person grows with it.

Review Rate review after 60 days based on performance.



How to Apply

We read every application carefully. A generic application will not be considered. Show us you have read this job description and that you understand what Adventure Luxury Leisure is.



Your application must include

1. Introduction Tell us who you are, what you do best, and why this role is the right fit for you. Specific, not generic.

2. Relevant experience What have you done that is directly relevant to this role? UGC, creator brands, design, outreach — be specific.

3. Portfolio Show us your Canva design work. Show us content you have created, edited, or managed. Links or attachments.

4. AI tools Tell us specifically how you use AI in your work. Which tools, for what tasks, how often.

5. The brand question In 2–3 sentences: what do you think Adventure Luxury Leisure's biggest content opportunity is, based on what you know about the brand from this job description?

6. Availability Confirm you are available to start immediately and can commit to the Monday 9am EST weekly handoff.

7. Subject line — REQUIRED Your application subject line must read exactly: “ALL in — VA Application”. Applications without this exact subject line will not be reviewed. This is your first test — read everything carefully.



Green flags — we want to see these

Specific examples Not 'I have experience with Canva' — 'I built a brand board for a travel creator that included X, Y, Z.'

Genuine brand interest References to the brand philosophy, the travel-as-medicine angle, or the content pillars signal you actually read this.

AI fluency You mention Claude, ChatGPT, or other specific tools and describe exactly how you use them.

Initiative You go beyond the application requirements — add something we didn't ask for that shows your thinking.



Red flags — these will disqualify your application

Generic opener 'Dear Hiring Manager, I am interested in this position' with no specific reference to ALL.

No portfolio Telling us you are good at Canva without showing us anything.

No answer to the brand question This tells us you did not read the description carefully.

Vague AI experience 'I use AI tools sometimes' is not an answer. Tell us specifically how.

title: Creative Marketing & Executive Support Specialist
description:
About Relentless Value Coaching:



Relentless Value Coaching (RVC) is a premier coaching organization serving financial advisors

through the DecaMillionaire Way framework. Founded by Justin Goodbread, CFP, CEPA,

CVGA, WSJ bestselling author, and EPI Hall of Fame inductee, RVC helps financial advisors

build, scale, and ultimately exit businesses at seven, eight, and nine-figure valuations. Our team

is lean, high-performing, and operates at the intersection of strategy, content, and business

growth.



Position Overview:



Relentless Value Coaching is seeking a Creative Marketing and Executive Support Specialist to join our team as a 1099 independent contractor. This is a full-time-hours, fully remote engagement beginning with a 90-day trial period, with a long-term working relationship offered upon successful completion of that trial.



This specialist reports directly to the Director of Operations and works alongside the Founder on select content, social media, and speaking initiatives. The two primary success drivers for this role are simple: social media leads and speaking engagements. Everything this person touches should move one or both of those needles.



This is not a task-taker role, and it is not a from-scratch creative role. We already produce first drafts in the Founder's voice, and we have a dedicated graphic designer. What we need is someone who can take what exists, finish it to a high standard, get it published, drive our
 and outreach, and keep the pipelines that generate leads and book the Founder on stages moving every day.



This role begins with execution and reporting in close partnership with the Director of Operations. For the right person, it is built to grow into full ownership of these workflows over time. We are looking for someone who wants that runway and is willing to earn it by consistently showing strong judgment and follow-through.



Key Responsibilities



Content Finishing and Publishing

• Refine existing first drafts into final, platform-ready posts for LinkedIn and YouTube. Drafts are generated in the Founder's voice already, so the work is editing and sharpening, not writing from a blank page.

• Schedule, publish, and optimize content across LinkedIn and YouTube in alignment with the RVC content calendar.

• Support the tea
mber who owns the YouTube channel with video repurposing and publishing coordination, including drafting titles, descriptions, and tags, and coordinating thumbnails.

• Keep the content calendar moving and ensure everything published is on brand, on time, and aligned with current campaign objectives.



Visual Coordination

• Plan the images and graphics each piece of content needs based on the content calendar, and brief our graphic designer with clear specs and direction. This role coordinates and directs visuals; it does not design them.



 Marketing

• Plan, build, and execute
 campaigns inside GoHighLevel, including nurture sequences and broadcasts, treating
 as a primary lead-nurturing and conversion channel we intend to grow aggressively.

• Draft and schedule
s, then test subject lines, sequencing, and calls to action to improve open and click-through performance over time.

• Report on
 performance on a defined cadence and bring clear recommendations for what to send next.

Support the creation of middle-of-funnel assets including lead magnets, nurture sequences, and campaign collateral.



Event and Promotion Support

• Support the promotion of RVC events, workshops, and Founder speaking appearances across organic and paid channels as directed.

• Help build, schedule, and coordinate promotional campaigns and creative, and flag performance issues proactively.

• Maintain clean records of promotional activity and outcomes for Director of Operations review.



Analytics and Reporting

• Monitor channel and campaign analytics weekly and deliver clear insights to the Director of Operations on what is driving leads and what is not.

• Track engagement and lead conversion activity and report findings on a defined cadence.



Speaker Booking Pipeline

• Research and build targeted outreach lists of conferences, associations, and events aligned with the Founder's keynote topics and target audience.

• Draft and send approved outreach for speaking bookings on behalf of the Founder, managed through LinkedIn Sales Navigator and
.

• Maintain and regularly update the RVC conference master reference list and Founder speaker kit.

• Track all outreach activity, follow-up timelines, and booking status, and report progress to the Director of Operations, who oversees this pipeline. Coordinate logistics and promotional materials for confirmed engagements.



Prospect and Community Outreach Pipeline

• Execute LinkedIn outreach and direct-message conversations that generate qualified leads, using Sales Navigator for audience targeting and list development, following approved messaging.

• Support the growth and engagement of the DecaMillionaire Way LinkedIn peer group, including audience building, conversation starting, and routing interested advisors to the appropriate next step.

• Track outreach activity, response rates, and lead status, and report to the Director of Operations so the prospect pipeline stays active and measurable.



Qualifications Required

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience backed by a strong portfolio.

• Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and YouTube Studio.

• Demonstrated ability to manage social media and
 campaigns with measurable engagement and lead generation results.

• Near-native written English is required. This role represents the Founder's brand directly in outreach to conference organizers and prospects, so all writing must be polished, professional, and error-free without supervision.

• Strong editing skills, with the ability to take an existing draft and sharpen it to a platform-ready standard while holding a consistent brand voice.

• Comfortable joining occasional video calls in clear, professional spoken English for coordination and check-ins. Booking and closing conversations remain with the leadership team.

• Comfortable working with AI tools as part of a standard production workflow.

• Ability to manage multiple active projects with full ownership and consistent follow-through, in a self-directed, remote, fast-moving environment.



Preferred

• Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

• Experience in the financial services, coaching, or professional development industry.

• Proven track record growing a YouTube channel or an
 list with measurable engagement and conversion outcomes.

• Experience supporting speaker outreach, conference booking, or executive PR for a personal brand.





Who You Are

title: Part-Time Video Editor & Social Media Publishing Specialist
description:
Part-Time Video Editor & Social Media Publishing Specialist

Compensation: $10–$12 per hour

Schedule: Approximately 20 hours per week

Location: Remote — Philippines

Employment Type: Part-time, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role

Probationary Period: 30 days



About the Role



We are a U.S.-based local business group operating several businesses in professional services, business education, and industrial services. We are hiring a skilled and reliable Video Editor and Social Media Publishing Specialist to turn long-form recordings and raw business footage into polished short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

This is primarily a video editing role, not a senior social media strategy position. You will receive clear brand guidelines, content direction, publishing plans, and feedback. Your job will be to execute that direction efficiently, produce strong video content, and publish it accurately across our social media accounts. The person who succeeds in this role will be dependable, responsive, coachable, detail-oriented, and capable of improving quickly through feedback.



What You Will Work On



The content will support several businesses and may include:

• Professional and educational talking-head videos

• Interviews and podcast-style conversations

• Investment banking and career recruiting content

• Industrial equipment and mobile trash-compaction videos

• Time-lapse videos showing equipment operating

• Business and entrepreneurship content



Most videos should have a clean, credible, and professional appearance. We are not looking for an overly aggressive TikTok editing style with excessive effects, flashing graphics, novelty filters, or distracting transitions.



Primary Responsibilities



Video Editing

• Review approximately two to four 30-minute videos per month.

• Identify strong short-form clips from each long-form recording.

• Turn each long-form video into approximately 10–15 short-form clips.

• Edit videos into vertical formats suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

• Keep most completed videos under two minutes.

• Remove filler words, unnecessary pauses, repeated statements, and weak sections.

• Create strong openings and maintain an effective pace.

• Add accurate captions and highlighted keywords.

• Add professional graphics, screenshots, charts, text overlays, and simple visual elements when appropriate.

• Create time-lapse videos from industrial equipment footage.

• Perform basic audio, color, lighting, cropping, and framing corrections.

• Use clean cuts, restrained transitions, and appropriate sound effects.

• Follow the visual standards and brand guidelines for each business.



Clip Selection

• Review long-form recordings and identify useful, engaging, and self-contained clips.

• Recognize 
nts that contain a clear lesson, tactic, opinion, demonstration, or strong visual result.

• Produce a strong first draft without requiring exact timestamps for every clip.

• Learn from feedback and improve your judgment about which clips should be selected.

• Develop greater independence as you become familiar with our businesses and audiences.



We will provide training and feedback, especially during the first several months. However, candidates who already demonstrate strong editorial judgment will distinguish themselves.



Social Media Publishing

• Publish and schedule approved content directly through company social media accounts.

• Post content to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

• Reuse approved clips across multiple platforms.

• Follow an established content calendar and publishing schedule.

• Schedule posts in advance using native platform scheduling tools.

• Enter appropriate titles, captions, hooks, hashtags, descriptions, and other metadata.

• Update the publishing tracker as content is completed, approved, scheduled, or requires follow-up.

• Confirm that posts have been published correctly.

• Monitor basic comments and engagement.

• Escalate questions, problems, or sensitive comments to the appropriate tea
mber.



You will not be responsible for creating the overall social media strategy or content calendar. Those will be provided to you.



Expected Workload



The anticipated workload includes:

• Two to four long-form videos per month

• Approximately 10–15 short clips from each long-form video

• Industrial and equipment footage edited into additional short-form videos

• Approximately 50–80 scheduled social media posts per month across the businesses

• An average publishing cadence of approximately one to two posts per day



The work will often be completed in batches. For example, you may edit a full set of clips, submit them for review, finalize them after feedback, and then schedule the approved content across several weeks.



Workflow. Our expected workflow is:

1. We provide the source video, brand guidance, and content direction.

2. You review the footage and prepare first-draft clips.

3. Each first draft should be approximately 70%–80% ready for publication, including captions and graphics.

4. We review the drafts and provide consolidated feedback.

5. You complete the revisions.

6. You schedule or publish the approved content.

7. You update the content tracker.



Most content should require one revision round after the initial training period. Some early assignments may require additional feedback while you learn our standards.



We value fast execution and short feedback cycles. Candidates should be able to work efficiently and generally provide initial work within one business day when the assignment size is reasonable.



Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience editing short-form vertical video

• Strong portfolio of TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts content

• Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, captions, and viewer retention

• Experience editing talking-head, interview, educational, or business content

• Ability to identify usable clips from longer recordings

• Experience publishing and scheduling content on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube

• Ability to create accurate captions and clean on-screen graphics

• Experience creating simple thumbnails or cover images

• Good written and spoken English

• Strong attention to detail

• Reliable communication and follow-through

• Ability to receive feedback professionally and apply it quickly

• Ability to manage multiple brands without confusing their visual styles or messaging

• Reliable computer and internet connection sufficient for downloading, editing, and uploading video files

• Ability to maintain organized files and follow established naming conventions



Preferred Qualifications



The following experience is helpful but not required:

• Riverside or a similar remote recording platform

• Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or another professional editing platform

• Canva, Photoshop, or similar graphic-design software

• AI-assisted editing, transcription, captioning, or copywriting tools

• Podcast or interview editing

• Educational or professional-development content

• Financial services, recruiting, business school, or career content

• Industrial, construction, equipment, or business-services content

• Basic community management

• Creating platform-specific hooks, hashtags, and metadata



We care more about the quality of your work than the specific software you use. You should be able to explain your workflow and consistently produce professional results.



Work Schedule and Communication

• Approximately four hours per day, five days per week

• Some flexibility in the exact schedule

• Preference for candidates who can work at least part of their shift during U.S. Central Time business hours

• A few hours of U.S. Central Time overlap will be required each week

• Approximately one scheduled tea
eting per week

• Most communication will be asynchronous through Slack

• Files will primarily be shared through Google Drive

• The role will be directly supervised by a U.S.-based business owner

• You will also communicate with other tea
mbers and marketing professionals as needed



What Success Looks Like

A successful person in this role:

• Produces clean and professional videos

• Meets deadlines consistently

• Responds promptly to messages and feedback

• Requires fewer revisions over time

• Learns which clips and editing approaches perform well

• Maintains accurate publishing schedules

• Does not miss captions, metadata, formatting, or platform details

• Keeps files, projects, and trackers organized

• Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting to be reminded

• Works quickly without sacrificing accuracy

• Becomes increasingly independent as they learn our standards



Growth Opportunity

This role will begin part-time, but it can grow into a full-time position.

We operate multiple businesses and expect our video and social media needs to continue expanding. A strong employee may eventually take on:

• Additional editing hours

• Greater responsibility for clip selection

• More independent publishing authority

• Social media performance reporting

• Content workflow management

• Coordination with other editors or contractors

• Broader responsibility for social media operations across multiple businesses



There is also an opportunity for increased hourly compensation based on performance, reliability, skill development, and expanded responsibility.



The better you perform, the more work and responsibility we can provide.



Hiring Process



Candidates selected to move forward may be asked to complete:

1. Online application questionnaire

2. Portfolio review

3. Initial interview

4. Short editing exercise or case study

5. Paid trial project



The paid trial project will allow both sides to evaluate editing quality, communication, turnaround time, judgment, and ability to apply feedback.



How to Apply



To be considered, you must complete the application questionnaire at the link below:



Video Editor & Social Media Specialist Application – Fill out form





Please follow all instructions in the questionnaire carefully.

The questionnaire will ask about your:

• Relevant work experience

• Editing software and workflow

• Social media platform experience

• Availability

• Internet and computer setup

• Portfolio

• Short-form video examples

• Experience selecting clips from long-form content

• Experience creating captions, graphics, thumbnails, and metadata



** Applications submitted without completing the above questionnaire will not be considered. **

title: DTC Performance Video Editor (Remote, Freelance)
description:
Creative studio producing performance ads for DTC brands on Meta is looking for a performance-driven video editor who understands that every cut, caption, and frame exists to convert — not to look pretty. You'll be editing across multiple client accounts, working from detailed briefs with creative direction. This is not a generic editing role. You're editing ads that need to stop the scroll, hold attention, and drive purchases. If you've never thought about how your editing decisions affect thumb stop rates, hold rates, and CPAs, this isn't the right fit.



You'll be cutting raw footage into final Meta ads — hooks, B-roll inserts, captions, pacing. Editing 15-25+ ad creatives per month across multiple client accounts. Working from detailed briefs with creative direction, pacing notes, and B-roll insertion cues. Exporting vertical 9:16 optimized for Meta placements. Iterating on winners — new hooks on proven bodies, format swaps, creator swaps. Building ads using AI tools when needed (voiceover, generated footage, etc.)



What you need



- Proven experience editing DTC or e-commerce video ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with real spend behind them

- A portfolio of ads that actually performed — bonus if you can share metrics

- Understanding of direct response fundamentals — hooks, hold rates, CTRs, CPAs, and how editing decisions affect each one

- Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

- Comfortable working with AI tools and willing to learn new ones fast

- Clean burned-in captions that match spoken audio

What you don't need



- Motion graphics or After Effects expertise

- A film degree

- 10 years of experience — if you've been editing DTC ads for 6 months and your work converts, that matters more than a decade of irrelevant work



Bonus



- You've built static ads in Canva

- You understand Meta's ad delivery system and why visual diversity matters

- You've worked with raw creator footage and know what's usable vs. what's not

- You're plugged into the DTC ad space — you follow the accounts, study the ads, know what's working right now



Details



- Remote, freelance

- Flexible hours but must hit weekly deadlines consistently

- Paid per deliverable, not hourly

- Payment within 48 hours of approved delivery

- Opportunity to grow into a full-time role as the studio scales

 examples of video ads or branded content you've edited. That's it.

title: Tech Operations & CRM Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



REVIO is a UK-based startup launching a first-of-its-kind platform for the professional hairdressing industry. We connect professional haircare brands with salon owners, self-employed stylists, and mobile hairdressers — giving them their own personalised online store to sell products to their clients and earn 20% commission on every sale.



We are pre-launch with a working platform, ready to go to market immediately. We need a Tech Operations and CRM Specialist to own the technical side of the business so the founder can focus on brand partnerships and growth.



You will work in a team of three: the founder (sales, strategy, partnerships), a marketing specialist (content, social media, brand voice), and you (systems, CRM, platform operations, onboarding). You need to understand the full business model, not just complete tasks.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



CRM and Marketing Automation (HubSpot):



 • Build
 workflows and automation sequences from scratch in HubSpot

 • Set up contact segmentation for 5 audiences: salon owners, self-employed stylists, mobile hairdressers, brands, and customers

 • Create and manage
 funnels for each audience type

 • Monitor automation performance and fix issues

 • Ensure all sign-ups flow into the correct
 sequences



Platform Operations:



 • Learn the REVIO platform inside out — every feature, every user flow, every button

 • Onboard new salons and stylists — guide them through sign-up, store setup, and sharing their product link

 • Provide first-line tech support and troubleshoot platform issues

 • Monitor orders, commissions, and flag any problems immediately

 • Document processes and create FAQ and help guides for users



Reporting and Data:



 • Track key metrics: sign-ups, active users, orders, conversion rates

 • Provide weekly reports on platform activity

 • Identify inactive users and trigger re-engagement

 • Monitor
 open rates and click rates, suggest improvements



REQUIREMENTS



Must-haves:



 • Proven experience BUILDING HubSpot workflows and
 automations from scratch (not just using an existing setup — show us what you have built)

 • Experience with CRM management and contact segmentation

 • Strong written and verbal English — you will communicate directly with UK-based salon owners and stylists

 • Comfortable learning new platforms quickly and independently

 • Problem-solver who takes ownership and does not wait to be told what to do

 • Available during UK business hours: 9am to 5pm GMT/BST

 • Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace



Nice-to-haves:



 • Experience with Stripe or payment platforms

 • Previous startup or SaaS company experience

 • Understanding of e-commerce or marketplace platforms

 • Experience with customer onboarding or customer success



ACCOUNTABILITY AND EXPECTATIONS



This is an exclusive full-time role. During your contracted hours (9am to 5pm UK time), you work solely on REVIO. Taking on other client work during these hours is grounds for immediate termination.



Daily reporting is required:



 • Morning check-in: what you are working on today

 • End-of-day summary: what you completed, any blockers

 • Response time: must reply to messages within 30 minutes during working hours



We use Hubstaff for time tracking during working hours. This is standard practice and non-negotiable.



Weekly 30-minute video call with the founder to review progress and priorities.



This is a results-driven role. We measure output, not hours staring at a screen. If you deliver consistently, you will thrive here. If you are looking for something easy to coast through, this is not it.



ABOUT THE TEAM



This is a startup environment. You will work directly alongside the founder and a marketing specialist. We move fast, communicate openly, and expect ownership. As the company grows, your role and compensation grow with it.



We are launching imminently and need someone who can hit the ground running, understand the full business, and take complete ownership of the technical operations from day one.



HOW TO APPLY



Send us:



 1. A brief introduction — who you are, where you are based, why this interests you

 2. A specific example of a HubSpot workflow or
 automation you have built — describe what it did and the result

 3. Your monthly rate expectation

 4. Your availability to start

 5. Confirmation you can commit exclusively during UK business hours



BONUS: Record a 2-minute Loom video walking us through a HubSpot automation you have previously built. This will put you ahead of other applicants.

title: Solar Appointment Setter / Outbound Cold Calling Specialist
description:
Solar Appointment Setter / Outbound Cold Calling Specialist



Remote | Philippines-Based | Full-Time



$6.25 – $9.25 USD/hour + Performance Bonuses | Paid in USD (Exchanged to PHP)



Can you make high-volume outbound calls every day, handle rejection, qualify homeowners, and book strong solar appointments for U.S.-based solar closers?



We are hiring a Solar Appointment Setter on behalf of a U.S.-based staffing and operations company supporting solar professionals and home service businesses. This role is for someone who is confident on the phone, highly coachable, competitive, and comfortable making cold outbound calls to homeowners.



This is not a customer service role. This is a cold outbound appointment-setting role for residential solar.



You will be expected to call leads, qualify homeowners, handle objections, and book appointments that have a real chance of turning into solar sales.



WHAT YOU’LL DO:



Cold Outbound Calling:



* Make high-volume outbound calls every working day



* Have 100+ outbound conversations or call attempts per day, depending on campaign volume and pickup rates



* Call homeowners and introduce the opportunity to explore solar savings



* Follow proven solar scripts while still sounding natural, confident, and conversational



* Open calls quickly, build interest, qualify the homeowner, and guide the conversation toward a solar consultation



* Handle rejection, objections, hang-ups, gatekeepers, and difficult conversations professionally



Solar Appointment Setting



* Book qualified solar appointments for U.S.-based solar closers or sales representatives



* Confirm homeowner interest, utility situation, roof ownership, location, and basic qualification details before booking



* Set accurate expectations so homeowners understand who they are meeting with and why



* Use strong confirmation language to reduce no-shows



* Schedule appointments accurately in the CRM or calendar



* Reschedule missed appointments when needed



* Help maximize the number of qualified appointments that actually show



Solar Lead Qualification



* Ask the right qualifying questions before booking an appointment



* Confirm whether the prospect owns the home



* Confirm the property is in an eligible service area



* Identify basic utility or electric bill information when required



* Determine whether the homeowner has interest in reducing energy costs



* Identify objections such as credit concerns, roof condition, timing, spouse approval, existing solar, or lack of interest



* Properly document all qualification details in the CRM



CRM & Pipeline Management



* Accurately update lead status after every call



* Log notes, call outcomes, objections, callback times, appointment details, and next steps



* Move leads through the correct pipeline stages



* Follow up with prospects through calls, SMS,
, or CRM tasks as required



* Keep the CRM clean, organized, and up to date



* Make sure closers have the information they need before each appointment



Performance & Accountability



* Track daily call volume, conversations, appointments booked, show rates, and lead quality



* Review call recordings and feedback to improve performance



* Participate in roleplay, coaching, and script training



* Improve objection handling, tone, pacing, confidence, and appointment-setting skill



* Bring energy and consistency every day, even when the calls are difficult



* Compete to improve booked appointments, show rate, and close rate



Communication



* Communicate clearly with the internal team about appointment quality, homeowner objections, bad data, and campaign feedback



* Flag wrong numbers, disconnected numbers, poor lead quality, duplicate leads, or market-specific issues



* Share what homeowners are saying so the team can improve scripts, offers, and follow-up



* Show up on time, stay organized, and keep your manager updated on performance



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



* Minimum 2 years of cold calling or outbound appointment-setting experience



* Experience setting appointments for solar, home services, roofing, HVAC, insurance, real estate, or similar outbound campaigns



* Strong spoken English with a clear, confident phone voice



* Experience making high-volume outbound calls



* Proven ability to book appointments from cold, aged, reactivation, or outbound lead lists



* Comfortable handling rejection and objections all day



* Strong listening skills and ability to control a conversation



* Ability to follow a script while sounding natural and human



* Strong CRM discipline and attention to detail



* Reliable, consistent, competitive, and coachable



* Ability to work independently without needing constant supervision



* Reliable home office setup with stable internet, backup internet, quality headset, and quiet work environment



* Ability to work Monday-Friday 9 am - 5 pm Pacific Standard Time (12 am-8 am Manila Time)



NICE TO HAVE:



* Direct experience setting residential solar appointments



* Experience calling homeowners in the United States



* Experience with solar objections such as “I’m not interested,” “I already looked into solar,” “I do not want a loan,” “my bill is too low,” “I need to talk to my spouse,” or “I already have solar”



* Experience with GoHighLevel, BatchDialer, ReadyMode, PhoneBurner, Aircall, JustCall, Dialpad, or similar dialers and CRMs



* Experience calling aged solar leads, cold lists, reactivation lists, or homeowner data



* Experience with SMS follow-up and appointment confirmation



* Experience working with U.S.-based solar closers or sales teams



* Experience with call recording review, QA scorecards, or sales coaching



* Prior experience booking appointments that resulted in completed solar consultations or closed solar deals



WHAT’S INCLUDED:



* $6.25–$9.25 USD/hour, paid in USD



* Approx. 65,000 – 96,000 PHP/month full-time before bonuses, depending on exchange rate and final hourly rate



* Performance bonuses for qualified appointments booked, completed appointments, show rate, and closed deals when applicable



* Fully remote, full-time position



* Full HMO benefits after 90 days of employment



* Clear growth path into Senior Solar Appointment Setter, Team Lead, Sales Development Lead, or Campaign Manager role



* Work with a fast-moving U.S.-based team serving solar professionals and home service businesses



HOW TO APPLY:



Send your resume and a short note, 3-5 sentences, describing your outbound appointment-setting experience.



Please include:



1. How many outbound calls you have made per day in a previous role

2. Whether you have experience setting solar appointments

3. What type of leads you called, such as cold data, aged leads, inbound leads, or reactivation lists

4. Your average appointments booked per day or per week

5. Your experience handling solar or home service objections

6. A short voice recording or Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you are strong on the phone



Applications without this note and voice recording will not be reviewed.



This position is placed through RevStone, a staffing and operations company supporting U.S.-based businesses.

 flyers to paid ad creatives.

s (holiday weekends, wedding season, retreat packages)

 templates in Canva that we can reuse and customize for different properties and offers

/Instagram Ads, and Pinterest Ads

 event covers

PR & Brand Presence (~5% of your time)

s to journalists, bloggers, and editors pitching Penrose Collective stories (property launches, unique guest experiences, design features, wedding offerings)

• Monitoring brand mentions across Google, social media, and review platforms and flagging anything worth responding to or amplifying

• Sourcing and coordinating gifted stay or press trip opportunities with travel influencers and content creators

• Maintaining a running PR tracker (target outlets, contact info, pitch status, follow-up dates)

• Supporting award or editorial submission opportunities (e.g., “Best Wedding Venues in Texas,” travel listicles, hospitality features)



What We’re Looking For



Must-Haves:

• 1+ year of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Strong proficiency in CapCut Pro (required) — Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve is a bonus

• Advanced Canva skills — you can design polished flyers,
 layouts, ad creatives, and social graphics quickly

• Deep understanding of what makes short-form content go viral — hooks, pacing, retention, trending audio

• Ability to write clean, persuasive ad copy and
 copy in English — not just edit visuals

• Eye for luxury/premium brand aesthetics — your designs should feel high-end, not templated

• Basic color grading and audio mixing skills for video

• Reliable internet and a machine that handles 1080p/4K footage

• Available 40 hours/week, Philippine time (flexible on exact hours)

• Self-starter who pitches ideas, not someone who waits to be told what to do



Strong Bonuses:

• Experience with AI tools (Runway, Pika, HeyGen, Opus Clip, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT for copy)

• Background creating content for hospitality, travel, wedding, real estate, or lifestyle brands

• Experience with
 marketing platforms (Mailchimp, Flodesk, or similar)

• Understanding of Google Ads / Meta Ads creative best practices

• Experience designing PDF lookbooks, pricing guides, or event packages

• Familiarity with Pinterest content strategy

• Experience growing a brand’s social following organically

• Prior PR, media outreach, or influencer coordination experience — even informal (running your own blog, pitching brands, managing collab partnerships)



How to Apply

To be considered, please send the following:



	1.	A short intro about yourself and why this role is a fit

	2.	2–3 video edits you’ve done (links preferred — Google Drive, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)

	3.	2–3 graphic design samples (Canva work, ad creatives,
 flyers, or social graphics)

Applications without samples will not be reviewed. We move fast — if it’s a fit, you’ll hear from us within a few days.

title: Senior Mobile and Web Developer (Flutter + Node.js)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are rebuilding a dating and social connection mobile app from the ground up and need a

senior-level developer who can own both the mobile application and the backend API that

powers it. This is a long-term, full-time remote position with a digital marketing and media

production company that serves multiple clients.



The dating platform rebuild is your primary and most important responsibility. You will be the lead

technical resource on that project, working directly with the project lead, owning the architecture

decisions, and building the app from a clean codebase on clean infrastructure.



In addition to the dating platform, you will also contribute to custom web development work

across other client projects during the interim period. These are custom web builds involving

PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and MySQL. This keeps the role full and productive while the

dating app is in active development.



This is not a maintenance or support role. We are building something new and we need

someone who takes ownership, communicates proactively, and executes without needing to be

managed on every task.



Mobile Development — Flutter (Required)

Flutter is our chosen framework for this project. We selected it specifically for its rendering

performance, visual consistency across iOS and Android, and its ability to deliver a premium

user experience from a single codebase. You must have strong, hands-on production

experience with Flutter.



REQUIRED MOBILE SKILLS:

Flutter with Dart, with a portfolio of shipped apps live in the App Store and Google Play

Cross-platform UI development with attention to smooth animations, gestures, and

responsive layouts



State management using Riverpod, Bloc, or Provider

REST API integration and mobile-to-backend communication

Firebase integration including Authentication, Firestore, and Cloud Messaging

Push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) and OneSignal

Real-time features including chat and live presence indicators

In-app purchases and subscription management for both iOS and Android

User authentication flows including social login via Google, Apple, and

App Store and Google Play submission, versioning, and update management

Geolocation and location-based features



Experience with CI/CD pipelines for Flutter, including cloud-based iOS builds via Codemagic

or Bitrise (Mac ownership is not required but you must have a reliable iOS build process)

Backend Development — Node.js (Required)



The backend API will be built in Node.js. You must be comfortable designing and building a

production-grade REST API that serves a mobile app with real-time requirements.



REQUIRED BACK END SKILLS:

Node.js with NestJS or Express for REST API development

PostgreSQL or MySQL for relational database design and management

Firebase Firestore for real-time data and chat functionality

JWT-based authentication and session management

Third-party API integration including Twilio, Agora, AWS S3, and OneSignal

AWS S3 for media storage and pre-signed URL generation

Environment-based configuration and deployment using .env and secure credential

management

Linux server management on Ubuntu including deployment, file permissions, and process

management

Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development

Web Development Skills

In addition to mobile and backend, this role requires solid custom web development skills for

admin panels, web-based dashboards, and supporting web pages.



REQUIRED WEB SKILLS:

PHP for custom server-side scripting and legacy code review

JavaScript, AJAX, and jQuery for dynamic front-end interactions

HTML5 and CSS3 for clean, responsive web interfaces

MySQL database administration

Ability to read and understand an existing PHP/Laravel codebase and document its

functionality

Additional Skills That Will Set You Apart

Prior experience taking over an existing mobile app project and migrating it to a new

codebase

Experience with Agora SDK for real-time audio and video features

Familiarity with Firebase Cloud Functions for serverless backend logic

Experience with payment gateway integrations for mobile subscriptions

Understanding of app store review guidelines and approval processes for both Apple and

Google



WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR IN A PERSON:

We need someone who communicates clearly and proactively. Not someone who goes quiet

when they hit a problem. You should be comfortable asking questions, flagging issues early, and

giving honest status updates.

This project requires someone who takes ownership. You will not be handed a detailed spec for

every task. You need to be able to look at a problem, propose a solution, and execute it.

Senior level means at least 5 years of professional development experience with real shipped

products in your portfolio. We will ask to see your work.



YOU MUST INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING PHRASE FOR YOUR APPLICATION TO BE CONSIDERED: I am an expert in both front and back end mobile development.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please include the following in your application:

1. Links to Flutter apps you have built that are live in the App Store or Google Play

2. Examples of Node.js or backend API projects you have worked on

3. Your experience with Flutter specifically and how many production apps you have shipped

4. How you handle iOS builds without a Mac, including what tools or services you use

5. Your availability, your time zone, and your expected monthly rate

6. A brief paragraph in your own words describing how you would approach taking over an

existing mobile app project and rebuilding it on a new codebase and tech stack



Applications without portfolio examples of live, shipped Flutter apps will not be reviewed.

title: Right-Hand VA (AI & Tech Focus) — Clean Christian Music App
description:
We're looking for a sharp, tech-curious right hand who loves using AI to make things run faster and smarter. The heart of this role is using AI to build — simple automations, internal tools, and reports that save our small team hours every week. If you get a little thrill from figuring out a new tool, automating something tedious, and making a process better than you found it, you'll fit right in.



It's a mixed role, and we want to be upfront about that. The AI, automation, and efficiency side is the core of what we're hiring for — but you'll also help with customer service for our clean Christian music app, a bit of marketing, and general admin, and you need to be genuinely open to pitching in wherever the team needs you. We use tools like Claude (and Claude Code) every day. You don't need to have done this before — but you do need to be excited to learn it.



If you anticipate what's needed before being asked, take real ownership, communicate like a pro, and love learning something new — keep reading.



We're hiring the person, not the résumé. Technical curiosity and drive matter most; the rest we can teach — including how we build with AI.



What you'll do



Build, automate, and make us more efficient with AI — use Claude / ChatGPT (and grow into Claude Code) to automate repetitive work, build simple internal tools, draft content, and find smarter, faster ways for the team to operate. This is the core of the role. We'll teach you; you bring the curiosity.



Turn data into insight — pull together clear daily reports and spot patterns (with AI's help). Bring us insights, not just numbers.



Be my right hand — anticipate needs, follow through without reminders, flag issues early, and close loops.



Support our clean Christian music app — customer service, content, and launch-related help.



Pitch in on the rest — influencer outreach, light e-commerce / Etsy support, and general admin as we grow.



A real love of music is a big plus — you'll be working in it every day.



Who you are (this matters most to us)



Technically curious — this is the big one. You enjoy poking at new tools, you're energized (not intimidated) by AI, and when you see a repetitive task your first instinct is "can I automate this?" Any interest in coding, automation, scripting, or tinkering is a real plus.



Great — not necessarily experienced. Eager, smart, proactive, and resourceful. We'd take a brilliant fast-learner over a seasoned coaster every single time.



A self-starter who takes initiative instead of waiting to be told, and teaches themselves what they don't know.



Open and flexible — happy to jump from an automation project to a customer-service question to a quick admin task without missing a beat. You're here for the technical work, but you don't consider anything "below" you.



A clear communicator — responsive, easy to work with, and good at keeping us in the loop.



Reliable and professional — you do what you say you'll do, and you have a stable internet connection good enough to hold a video call and screen-share without dropping.



Honest and accountable — you log the time you actually work and speak up early when something's off. This one is non-negotiable.



Detail-oriented. To show us you read carefully, please mention your favorite color in your application where it asks how you heard about us.



Mission-aligned — you genuinely connect with what we're building: clean, faith-friendly music for families.



Helpful (but NOT required — we'll train you)



AI & automation — bonus points for hands-on Claude / Claude Code experience, automation work (n8n, Make, Zapier), or any interest in coding or scripting.



Using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools in your daily workflow.



Data analysis (with AI's help) to generate reports and spot trends.



Pinterest / social media scheduling tools.



Customer service experience.



WordPress publishing and AI image generation (e.g., Ideogram, gpt-image).



Influencer outreach and management.



The details:



Full-time, 40 hrs/week, long-term.



We start at $400–500/month and there's room to grow — in both pay and responsibility — as you take on more and grow into the AI/automation side.



Based in the Philippines, with some flexibility to occasionally overlap U.S. Mountain Time for a quick call or chat.



We use the time tracker Trackabi for active work hours.



Benefits



Flexible hours — days, nights, spread out, or catch up on weekends.



PTO after 6 months full-time.



Paid training time to learn new skills on the clock.



A genuinely great team and culture. I treat my team like friends, not just freelancers — many have been with me for years, with no plans of leaving.



How to apply



Apply through the Google Form here:
— that's the only way to apply, so please don't DM or
 instead.



Two quick things in the form:



When it asks about your experience with AI tools, tell us about a time you taught yourself a new tool, or automated or figured out something you'd never done before — what you did and how it turned out. There's no "right" answer; we just want to see how you think and learn.



We're hiring one person and reviewing applications as they come in. Top candidates get a paid test project — your real chance to show us how you work.



If the AI and automation side sounds more like a chore than a challenge you'd enjoy, this probably isn't the right fit — and that's completely okay. But if everything above sounds like you, we'd genuinely love to meet you.

title: Dispatcher - Customer Service with Emergency Response Background
description:
Job description:



Remote · $10–$12/hr · Full Time · U.S. Company hiring from the Philippines



About SureFire CPR



SureFire CPR helps people get the lifesaving training and certifications they need, when they need them.



We run a 24/7 CPR training operation so students can get real support, complete their certification, and actually feel confident doing it.



Our mission is simple: equip people with the skills to save lives. We operate across 100+ locations and are scaling to 1,000 before 2029, which means more people who can step in when it counts, for a coworker, a patient, a stranger, a child.



When a student calls for help, the person who picks up represents everything we're trying to do.



Who We Are



We help people save lives. That's it. 24 hours a day, every day.



Three values run through everything we do, including, how we hire, how we coach, how we lead, and how we show up for students. They're not a tagline. They're non-negotiable.



We Set the Pace. We move fast, get it done, and are proud of it. We take proactive, bold action and let nothing stand in our way. We’re resourceful, methodical and curious. We take others with us. We don’t wait to be told. We just go. Because the work matters.



Make It Simple. Simple isn’t easy - it’s a choice we make on purpose. We take the extra time to remove anything that isn’t essential, and we step back often to make sure we're still focused on what matters most. Because complexity is the enemy of execution.



Care Deeply. About the impact. About doing things right. About each other. We do more - the little bit extra that surprises people and makes them feel special. We never stop at “good enough.” Because caring deeply helps save lives.



A Note from the Head of Delivery



Our students are nurses, parents, coaches, teachers, first responders. A lot of them are anxious. Some are frustrated. A few are calling during genuinely hard 
nts.



The person who answers sets the tone.



We need someone who can stay calm, listen well, and give clear direction without making the student feel like a burden. Someone who follows the process, communicates with care, and stays with the problem until it's solved.



You don't need CPR training experience — we'll teach you everything you need to know.



But if you've worked in healthcare support, EMS, 911 dispatch, technical support, or any environment where urgency and empathy had to coexist, you'll get up to speed fast.



Here's what we're looking for:



    You own the call. No deflecting, no passing the buck.

    You communicate clearly, even when the student is flustered.

    You follow the process and sweat the details.

    You can be kind and firm at the same time.

    You care about why this work matters, not just what the task is.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.



What You'll Do



You are the student's point of contact when something goes wrong, something is confusing, or they just need someone to walk them through it. Your job is to resolve it on that call, whenever possible.



Answer with urgency. You move first. You don't let confusion sit and turn into frustration.



Treat every call like it matters. Because to that student, it does. They may need this certification for a job, a license, a deadline.



Document everything. Accurate notes, correct dispositions, updated systems. The next person who touches that account needs to know what happened.



Bring problems forward. If you're hearing a question without a dedicated response in our system, that's a signal. You flag it so training can fix it.



What Success Looks Like



    Students leave the call knowing exactly what to do next

    Issues get resolved with you, not transferred to someone else

    Every interaction is documented accurately

    Recurring gaps in the process get surfaced and fixed

    Students get the same quality of support whether they call at 2pm or 2am



How You'll Work



This is a 24/7 operation. Shifts may include evenings, weekends, holidays, or overnight hours depending on business needs. Reliability isn't optional. Students are counting on us to pick up.



You'll work closely with the rest of the Delivery Team:



Training & QA — When you spot a recurring question or a confusing instruction, you bring it to them. They build the fixes; you give them the raw material.



Facilities — When a location issue affects a student's experience, you document it and escalate it properly.



Dispatch Team — You communicate clearly with your teammates, share context, and help maintain coverage. No student falls through the cracks because a hand off was sloppy.



What You Bring



    Strong spoken and written English

    Experience in emergency response work — Emergency response, technical support, dispatch, or similar

    A track record of helping frustrated or anxious people without getting rattled

    Attention to detail and accurate documentation habits

    Comfortable picking up new platforms and tools quickly

    The ability to follow a process closely, and to ask when something isn't clear

    An ownership mindset — you don't wait to be told to care



Helpful Background



Any of these will help you ramp faster, but none are required:



Healthcare or medical scheduling support · EMS or 911 dispatch · CPR, BLS, ACLS, or First Aid experience



What Won't Work Here



    Guessing instead of asking

    Transferring problems you could have solved

    Getting defensive with frustrated students

    Skipping documentation because it feels like extra work

    Treating this like ordinary customer service



It isn't ordinary. The standard stays the same whether it's busy, slow, or 3am.



How to Apply



Record a Loom video — 3 minutes max — answering two questions:



    Tell us about a time you helped a frustrated or confused customer. What happened, and what did you do?

    Why this role?



We're not looking for a polished pitch. We want to hear how you communicate and how you think.



Upload your resume, your Loom link, and your written responses to questions at the link below. We only take applicants who apply through this form:







In the "Anything else?" field, begin your first sentence with one of our values.



Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.



Benefits:



    Paid training

    Work from home



Work Location: Remote

 to showcase our tutoring style and attract new students.

Note: This is a long-term position. If you are prone to disappearing, ignoring texts, or taking on too many clients at once, please do not apply. We value open communication above all else. For a candidate who demonstrates exceptional teaching results, high client retention, and helps drive lead generation through social media, we offer an exclusive profit-sharing model paying out up to $100 AUD to $500 AUD+ per month as a performance bonus on top of your base pay. 



Technical Curriculum Requirements

You must be highly proficient in teaching the following subjects (equivalent to advanced university-prep mathematics):

1. Mathematical Methods (Calculus, Functions & Probability)

Functions & Relations: Polynomial, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric, and piecewise functions.  

Algebra & Graphing: Transformations, matrices, and graphing techniques.  

Differential Calculus: Product/chain/quotient rules, optimization, and rates of change.

Integral Calculus: Indefinite and definite integrals, and area under curves.

Probability & Statistics: Discrete/continuous distributions, sample proportions, and confidence intervals.



2. Specialist Mathematics (Advanced Calculus, Mechanics & Proofs)

Advanced Algebra: 

Complex numbers (polar form), vectors, and matrix transformations.

Trigonometry & Functions: Identities, 2D/3D applications, rational, and parametric functions.

Advanced Calculus: Differential equations and advanced integration techniques.  

Mechanics (Physics-Math): Kinematics, forces, and motion in 2D/circular paths.

Proofs: Mathematical induction and formal logic.



3. General Mathematics (Applied Math)

Data analysis (statistics), financial modeling (recursion), networks, and decision maths.  



Calculator Requirements (CRITICAL)

Australian students are heavily assessed on their ability to use advanced graphic calculators. You must be able to teach calculator shortcuts, graphing, and calculus functions on at least one (ideally both) of these systems:

TI-Nspire CX CAS

Casio ClassPad II



Hardware & Setup Requirements

A degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Secondary Education (Math major), or a highly quantitative field.

Flawless, charismatic English—both for teaching teenagers and engaging viewers on social media videos.

Other Requirements

Communication: Flawless written and spoken English. You must be able to explain abstract, complex concepts in simple terms.

ABOUT US

Meander Digital is the digital marketing partner of choice for founder-led and expert-led service-based businesses.



We help our clients rise above their competition and become recognised in the marketplace for their expertise through timeless sales and marketing strategies.



Our work spans direct response advertising (performance marketing), lead generation, personal branding, and content marketing.



We run lean by design. Our core team is small — the Founder, an Executive Assistant, and you — supported by a trusted network of freelance specialists. We believe that in an AI-enabled world, a capable, cross-functional operator can create the kind of leverage that used to require several separate hires.



We are not looking for someone to stay inside one narrow job scope.



We are looking for a T-shaped marketer — someone with real depth in one craft and the range to contribute across many — who enjoys making themselves useful across the business and quietly makes the whole team more effective.



"A jack of all trades is a master of none, but oftentimes better than a master of one."



That, in one line, is who we're looking for.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF…

- You only want to specialise in one function and have no interest in learning adjacent skills.

- You instinctively say "that's not my job" rather than "what do I need to learn to move this forward?"

- You wait for instructions instead of looking for problems to solve.

- You dislike standard operating procedures, documentation, and organised systems.

- You treat AI-generated work as a finished product.

- You are looking for a short-term stepping stone before your next opportunity.

- You become stressed when priorities change in a fast-moving agency environment.



YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU ARE…



- A T-shaped marketer — broad across many disciplines, with real depth in at least one. For this role, your deepest craft is copywriting and content; graphic design and short-form video are functional adjacent skills. (Our designer owns final polish; you'll collaborate with them when assets need it.)



- AI-enabled and resourceful — you use modern AI tools to work across research, copy, design, and video at a level that used to require several people.



- Someone with real taste and an eye for design — you know what "good" looks like, even when you're not the one polishing it.



- A trend-spotter — you keep a close pulse on content and ad formats, and can tell what's working right now versus what's losing steam.



- High ownership — you ask "what do I need to learn to move this forward?" rather than "that's not my job."



- Someone who communicates with maturity and emotional intelligence — able to build trust with clients, teammates, and partners from different cultures and backgrounds.



- Reliable and consistent — people know they can depend on you.



- Naturally organised and enjoy creating order.



- Comfortable switching between creative work and operational work.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Content & Marketing Support



- Conduct audience, competitor, and industry research

- Draft AI-assisted ad copy,
s, landing pages, and social media content

- Set up and launch Meta ads campaigns (campaign optimisation stays with the Founder/media buyer)

- Repurpose long-form content into short-form assets

- Build and maintain swipe files and research libraries



Creative Production (to a functional standard — our designer owns final polish)



- Create and edit graphics in Canva

- Resize and adapt existing ad creatives

- Edit short-form videos using CapCut or equivalent software

- Generate and refine AI-generated images where appropriate

- Collaborate with our designer when an asset needs a higher level of polish



Operations & Coordination (a supporting role — our Executive Assistant owns this area)



- Help coordinate workflow between internal tea
mbers and freelancers

- Work alongside the Executive Assistant — not in place of her — as the subject-matter/technical point of contact for tea
mbers, freelancers, and clients on marketing and creative work, keeping communication clear and timely (the Founder owns client strategy and decisions)

- Support the Executive Assistant in following up on outstanding tasks and commitments, with firmness and tact, keeping projects moving without unnecessary friction

- Help maintain clear communication across a geographically distributed team spanning Singapore, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Malaysia

- Help track deliverables and keep projects moving forward

- Maintain organised file structures and digital assets

- Contribute to SOPs, checklists, and internal documentation



Marketing the Business (our own agency marketing and the founder's personal brand)



- Help publish case studies and keep our website current

- Support
 marketing, social media content, and lead generation initiatives

- Turn the founder's ideas, talks, and raw recordings into publishable assets — LinkedIn content, long-form articles, video, podcast repurposing

Internal Projects & Documentation



- Help move internal projects from idea to implementation — SOP creation, AI implementation, knowledge base development, workflow optimisation

From time to time you'll also provide secondary support on meeting preparation and reporting or data consolidation. You are not expected to replace specialists — you're expected to become competent enough to provide continuity when required.



WORKING ENVIRONMENT



Fully remote, full-time, with fixed hours of 9am–6pm Singapore time. If you're based in the Philippines, Indonesia, or Malaysia, that's regular daytime hours — we share a similar time zone.



Collaborative work with our international core team and a trusted network of freelance writers, designers, and specialists across Singapore, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Malaysia.

- Get access to all tools (BrightLocal, Semrush, etc.)

WEEK 3-4: START MANAGING CLIENTS

MONTH 2: TAKE FULL RESPONSIBILITY

- Fix technical SEO issues (coordinate with dev team)

- Track and report ranking progress to clients

 

MONTH 3: OPTIMIZE & SCALE

- Spot upsell opportunities (additional services)

? Average client ranking improvement within 90 days

? Zero missed deadlines or communication lapses

? Positive client feedback and satisfaction

? Proactive identification of ranking opportunities

 

============================================================

 

REQUIRED SKILLS

 

MUST HAVE:

 

• 2+ years of professional SEO experience

• Proven track record of managing client SEO campaigns

• Expert-level knowledge of BrightLocal OR similar local SEO tool (rank tracking, citation audits, GBP management)

• Expert-level knowledge of Semrush OR Ahrefs (site audits, keyword research, competitive analysis)

• Strong understanding of Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4

• Solid knowledge of technical SEO fundamentals (Core Web Vitals, page speed, crawlability, XML sitemaps, indexing)

• Strong written English communication skills (you'll write client reports)

• Detail-oriented and organized (managing multiple client accounts)

• Experience with local SEO for service-based businesses (contractors, home services, plumbers, roofers, etc.)

 

CANNOT HIRE IF:

 

? No verifiable SEO experience

? Cannot demonstrate proficiency with BrightLocal or Semrush

? Poor English writing skills

? History of unreliability (missed deadlines, ghosting)

? Claims to guarantee rankings (we know SEO doesn't work that way)

 

============================================================

 

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS

 

• Experience creating reports in Google Data Studio

• Knowledge of WordPress or Next.js/React

• Experience with on-page content optimization

• Knowledge of link building and backlink analysis

• Familiarity with HubSpot CRM

 

============================================================

 

COMPENSATION

 

• $5-7 per hour (based on your experience level and demonstrated SEO expertise)

• Rate increases available after 90 days of excellent performance

• Performance bonuses based on client satisfaction and results

 

============================================================

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

• Someone who takes ownership of client results

• Clear, proactive communicator

• Ability to work independently (minimal micromanagement)

• Long-term mindset (wants to build something real, not just earn quick money)

• Understands that SEO is a long-term game (not quick fixes or black-hat tactics)

 

============================================================

 

FAQS

 

Q: Do I need to be in the United States?

A: No. This is a 100% remote position. Work from anywhere.

 

Q: What if I don't have experience with BrightLocal?

A: We can train you on BrightLocal - it's easy to learn. However, you MUST have solid, verifiable SEO experience.

 

Q: Will I need to do sales or cold calling?

A: No. You manage existing client accounts only. No sales, no outreach, no calling.

 

Q: How long is the commitment?

A: We ask for a 3-month trial period. After that, we discuss ongoing arrangement and potential rate increases.

 

Q: Can I work on other projects simultaneously?

A: Yes, as long as you meet all our deadlines and there are no conflicts of interest.

 

Q: What's your SEO methodology?

A: We focus on:

   - Local SEO (rank tracking via BrightLocal, GBP optimization, citation management)

   - Technical SEO (site audits, Core Web Vitals, crawlability fixes)

   - On-page optimization (keyword research, content strategy, internal linking)

   - Monthly white-label reporting (dashboards showing rankings, traffic, ROI)

 

============================================================

 

ABOUT EXPONENTIAL OAKS

 

• Digital marketing and web development agency

• Based in Atlanta, GA (fully remote team)

• Services: Web Development + SEO +
 Marketing

• Focus: Small businesses and service contractors (home services, roofers, plumbers, HVAC, remodelers)

• Team: Small, professional, growing fast

• We're scaling and need reliable people to join us

 

============================================================

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Please submit your application on OnlineJobs.PH with:

 

1. YOUR RESUME/CV

   - Highlight your SEO experience (years, tools used, specific results/improvements)

   - Include links to case studies or portfolio examples (if you have them)

2. COVER LETTER (1-2 paragraphs)

title: YouTube Video Assembler
description:
# Job Title



YouTube Video Assembler — Python Pipeline + CapCut (Ongoing, Paid Per Video)



# Job Description



I run a YouTube channel that produces educational videos using a Python-based content pipeline. I need a reliable person to operate the pipeline and assemble the final videos in CapCut.



This is not a coding job. You don't need to write or debug Python — you just need to run pre-built scripts in the correct order and wait for them to finish. The real requirement is a fast computer that can handle AI and video rendering without crawling to a halt.



## The Workflow



For each video, I'll send you a script and background music. You will:



1. Run the voiceover Python script

2. Run the image generation Python script

3. Run the video segment Python script

4. Import everything into CapCut - Background music, Caption, Export



Once you've done a few rounds, this becomes a fast, repeatable process.



## What You Need



- A powerful computer — a MacBook Pro M4 (or similar Apple Silicon Mac, or an equally fast Windows machine with a strong CPU/GPU) is required. The Python scripts are resource-intensive; underpowered laptops will struggle and slow down delivery.

- CapCut installed (pro version)

- Comfort running terminal commands / Python scripts (copy-paste level, no coding skills required)

- Basic video editing sense — clean cuts, readable captions, music that doesn't drown out the voiceover

- Reliable internet and the ability to hit weekly deadlines



## Volume & Pay



- Starting at 7 videos per week

- Potential to scale to 14 videos per week based on performance and reliability

- $5 per completed, exported video

- Paid weekly or monthly



## Time Commitment



Each video should take a modest amount of hands-on time once you're set up (mostly waiting on scripts to run, then a quick CapCut assembly). This is a great fit for someone looking for steady part-time, repeatable work rather than a single project.



## How to Apply



Please include in your application:



1. What computer/laptop you'll be using (model and specs)

2. Confirmation you have or can install CapCut

3. Any experience running scripts via terminal/command line (even basic)

4. Your availability per week

5. One sentence on why this role fits what you're looking for



I'm looking to start with a short trial batch (a few videos) before committing to the full weekly volume, so we can both make sure the workflow is a good fit.
