title: Community & Brand Ambassador
description:
# Job Description: Community & Brand Ambassador



## Company: BRUMICON



## Position Type: Full-Time



## Reports To: Operations Manager



## Compensation: P20,000 - P40,000 (Based on skills and experience)



## About BRUMICON



BRUMICON is an entertainment studio centered mainly on creating high-quality video games and interactive experiences. Our mission is built into our name:



**BRU — Bringing Real Unity**

**MI — Meaningful Interactions**

**CON — Combining Our Narratives**



We believe games are more than entertainment. They bring people together, create shared stories, and build communities that players want to return to. BRUMICON is looking for a passionate and energetic **Community & Brand Ambassador** to help grow our brand, connect with players, and become one of the public voices of our company.



This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to enter the gaming, entertainment, and social media field and grow with a creative studio from the ground up.



---



## Role Overview



The **Community & Brand Ambassador** will help manage BRUMICON’s public presence across social media, livestreaming platforms, and gaming communities. This person will create content, engage players, host livestreams, build excitement around BRUMICON, and help grow our audience.



The ideal candidate is a natural entertainer: confident, charismatic, energetic, creative, and comfortable talking to strangers. They should enjoy gaming culture, love connecting with people online, and be able to make viewers feel welcomed, entertained, and excited to follow BRUMICON.



This role is especially focused on engaging the Filipino gaming community, while also helping BRUMICON reach players from other countries.



---



## Key Responsibilities



### Social Media & Brand Management



* Manage and help grow BRUMICON’s social media presence across platforms such as:



  *

  * TikTok

  * YouTube

  * Instagram

  * X/Twitter

  * 

  * Twitch or other livestreaming platforms, if needed

* Create regular posts, videos, updates, announcements, 
s, short-form content, community questions, and promotional material.

* Maintain a consistent posting schedule and brand voice.

* Help build hype, recognition, and excitement around BRUMICON and its projects.

* Monitor comments, messages, reactions, and community feedback.

* Respond to players and followers in a friendly, professional, and engaging way.



---



### Video Content & Livestreaming



* Appear on camera for videos, livestreams, announcements, interviews, updates, and community content.

* Host livestreams for gameplay, community events, Q&A sessions, contests, previews, and special announcements.

* Record, edit, and publish short-form and long-form video content.

* Create entertaining content that helps viewers feel connected to BRUMICON.

* Help develop a recognizable online personality for the brand.

* Learn and improve livestreaming techniques over time.



Prior professional livestreaming experience is not required, but the candidate must be confident, engaging, and willing to learn.



---



### Community Engagement



* Help build and manage BRUMICON’s player community, especially on 
 and social platforms.

* Welcome new community members and encourage positive interaction.

* Start conversations, polls, challenges, discussions, and community activities.

* Gather player feedback and report important trends, questions, and concerns to the Operations Manager.

* Help create a fun, respectful, and exciting community atmosphere.

* Encourage players to feel that they are part of BRUMICON’s journey.



---



### Contests, Events & Collaborations



* Plan and help host online contests, giveaways, challenges, and community events.

* Collaborate with gamers, streamers, influencers, creators, and community leaders.

* Help identify potential partners and influencers who fit BRUMICON’s brand.

* Coordinate promotional activities to increase brand recognition and player engagement.

* From time to time, attend public gaming events, competitions, conventions, or community gatherings when requested.

* Conduct casual interviews with players, creators, influencers, or event participants when needed.



Travel may occasionally be required for public events, gaming competitions, or promotional activities.



---



### Story-Based Brand Content



* Help create fictional story-based content that supports BRUMICON’s brand and intellectual properties.

* Assist with ideas for animated or voice-acted episodes, character-driven shorts, lore-based videos, and narrative promotional content.

* Help write or develop episode ideas, scripts, voice lines, and social media story content.

* Participate as a host, narrator, voice actor, or on-camera personality when appropriate.

* Coordinate with editors, animators, artists, writers, or voice actors when needed.

* Promote story-based episodes across BRUMICON’s social platforms.



---



### Content Planning & Reporting



* Help maintain a content calendar for social media posts, videos, livestreams, contests, and community events.

* Track basic performance metrics such as follower growth, livestream viewers, engagement, content consistency, and player feedback.

* Report what content performs well and suggest ways to improve future content.

* Stay aware of gaming trends, Filipino gaming culture, 
s, popular creators, and current social media formats.

* Bring creative ideas to the team regularly.



---



## Required Qualifications



* Must be based in the Philippines.

* Must speak and write English very well.

* Must speak Tagalog.

* Strong interest in gaming and gaming culture.

* Comfortable appearing on camera.

* Comfortable speaking with strangers online and in person.

* Confident, energetic, and naturally engaging personality.

* Able to create regular social media content.

* Able to host or learn to host livestreams.

* Able to communicate clearly and professionally with players and followers.

* Creative mindset with a strong sense of what makes content entertaining.

* Reliable, organized, and able to follow a content schedule.

* Willing to learn new tools, platforms, and content creation skills.

* Willing to occasionally travel for gaming events, competitions, or promotional activities when needed.



---



## Preferred Qualifications



The more of these skills the candidate has, the better:



* Experience creating TikTok,
, YouTube, Instagram, or livestream content.

* Experience managing a 
 community.

* Experience with gaming communities, esports, online games, mobile games, PC games, indie games, or card/strategy games.

* Experience recording and editing short-form videos.

* Experience hosting livestreams, interviews, events, or community activities.

* Experience collaborating with influencers, gamers, streamers, or creators.

  * Streamlabs

  *

  * TikTok Studio

  * YouTube Studio

  * Google Workspace

  * Trello, Notion, Asana, or similar project tools

* Other Filipino languages, such as Cebuano or others, are a bonus.



---



## Ideal Personality Fit



We are looking for someone who is:



* Charismatic

* Confident

* Creative

* Energetic

* Comfortable talking to new people

* A natural entertainer

* Friendly and approachable

* Passionate about games

* Excited to build a community

* Able to make people smile, laugh, and feel included

* Comfortable being one of the public faces of the BRUMICON brand



This role is not just about posting content. It is about helping people feel connected to BRUMICON.



---



## Success Metrics



Success in this role may be measured by:



* Growth of BRUMICON’s social media followers.

* Growth of livestream viewers and repeat viewers.

* Consistency and quality of posted content.

* Community engagement and player interaction.

* Quality of player feedback gathered and reported.

* Growth and activity of the 
/community space.

* Successful contests, events, and collaborations.

* Increased brand recognition among gamers, especially within the Filipino gaming community.



---



## Work Setup



This is a full-time, fully remote position for someone based in the Philippines. The role may require flexible hours at times, especially during livestreams, gaming events, community activities, or collaborations with creators in different time zones.



Occasional travel may be required for public gaming events, competitions, conventions, interviews, or promotional appearances.



---



## How to Apply



Interested applicants should submit:



* Resume or short work profile.

* Links to any social media pages, videos, livestreams, gaming content, or sample work, if available.

* A short intro video introducing yourself.



In your intro video, please include:



* Your name.

* Your location in the Philippines.

* Languages you speak.

* Your gaming background.

* Why you are interested in BRUMICON.

* Why you think you would be a great Community & Brand Ambassador.



Prior professional experience is helpful, but not required. We are looking for someone with the right personality, creativity, passion for gaming, and ability to connect with people.

title: Inbound & Outbound Caller — Business & Real Estate Loan Lead Handler
description:
Black Stone Ridge Capital (BSRC) is a business and real estate lending firm based in Austin, TX. We match business owners, real estate investors, and property owners with the right lender in 24 hours — no paperwork upfront. We work with 7,500+ lenders nationwide across all 50 states.



We need a reliable caller to handle TWO functions:

(1) Answer inbound calls from our website and qualify borrowers live

(2) Make outbound calls to warm web leads AND cold pre-foreclosure property owners from our PropStream lead list



All qualified leads are logged in our CRM (GoHighLevel) for immediate callback by our senior advisor.



OUR 7 LOAN PRODUCTS (you will be fielding calls on all of these):

- Commercial Real Estate

- SBA Loan

- DSCR / Rental Property

- Business Line of Credit

- Equipment Financing

- Merchant Cash Advance

- Other Business & Real Estate Financing



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Answer inbound calls from our website — greet callers professionally, qualify them using our script, and route to the senior advisor

- Call outbound web leads within 30–60 minutes of submission

- Make outbound cold calls to pre-foreclosure property owners (empathetic, solutions-focused approach — full script provided)

- Pull and organize lead lists from PropStream and InvestorLift

- Collect key data on every call: loan type, amount needed, state, credit range, and best callback time

- Log ALL call outcomes in GoHighLevel CRM using our provided template

- Flag hot leads immediately via text to the senior advisor

- Handle 20–60 calls per day (inbound + outbound combined)



REQUIREMENTS:

- Fluent, clear spoken English — neutral accent strongly preferred

- Comfortable making cold and warm outbound calls — THIS IS THE PRIMARY ROLE, not admin

- Prior experience with lead generation tools (PropStream, InvestorLift, BatchLeads, or similar)

- Reliable internet, quality headset, and quiet calling environment

- UPS or backup power source for Philippine power outages

- Available during US business hours: 9 AM – 6 PM Central Time, Monday–Friday

- Basic CRM data entry skills (GoHighLevel training provided)

- Prior experience in financial services, real estate, or telemarketing is a strong plus



NICE TO HAVE:

- Knowledge of DSCR/rental property loans, bridge loans, SBA, MCA, or equipment financing

- Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRM

- Experience calling motivated sellers or pre-foreclosure leads



HOW TO APPLY — All 4 required or your application will not be reviewed:

1. Describe your outbound cold calling experience in 2–3 sentences

2. Describe your lead generation experience — what tools have you used?

3. Write the phrase "I am comfortable making cold calls" to confirm you read this post

Applications without a voice sample will NOT be considered.

title: Social Media Manager / Short-Form Video Editor (CapCut, TikTok, AI-Forward)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I run Remarkable Career, a boutique executive search firm, and I'm looking for a sharp, fast, AI-forward social media manager and short-form video editor to own our content across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. The content is a mix of company/recruiting content (career advice, hiring, the job search, executive search) and personal brand content (building me up as the face of the business).



This is a hands-on creator role. I want someone who can pump out a high volume of content quickly, turn around FAST edits when I need them, and bring real ideas to the table -- not just wait for instructions. If you love the editing craft, you live inside CapCut, and you're genuinely excited about using AI to work faster, keep reading.



SCHEDULE & PAY

- Part-time, roughly 20 hours/week, fully remote

- Pay: $300-$500 USD/month, depending on experience and portfolio

- You must have a few hours of daily overlap with U.S. business hours for quick turnarounds and check-ins



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) that are clean, punchy, and on-trend

- Turn raw footage around FAST -- quick edits and rapid revisions are a core part of this job

- Add B-roll, captions, hooks, transitions, sound, and on-screen text to make videos pop

- Write scroll-stopping captions and hooks for each post

- Build and maintain a content calendar so we always know what's going out and when

- Bring ideation and strategy -- pitch content ideas, formats, series, and trends to jump on

- Use AI tools to streamline everything: scripting, repurposing, captioning, B-roll sourcing, ideation, and batching



WHO YOU ARE

- Strong editor -- you know pacing, cuts, captions, and retention

- CapCut power user -- this is non-negotiable; you should be fast and fluent in it

- TikTok-native -- you understand what works on the platform and why

- AI-forward and forward-thinking -- you already use AI tools to move faster and you're always testing new ones. There are so many tools that make this work easier, and I want someone hungry to use them

- Fast -- you can produce a lot of good content quickly without sacrificing quality

- A self-starter who brings ideas, not just execution



REQUIRED: PORTFOLIO (please read carefully)

Do NOT apply without a portfolio. I will not review applications that don't include one. Your portfolio should show:

- Past accounts you've created content for (handles/links so I can see the actual accounts)

- Sample videos you've edited -- ideally short-form (TikTok/Reels/Shorts)

- Any before/after or raw-to-final examples if you have them

- A quick note on which parts were YOUR work (editing, captions, strategy, etc.)

Applications without a reviewable portfolio of real past work will not be considered.



HOW TO APPLY

Send me:

1. Your portfolio (links to past accounts and sample videos)

2. A short note on the AI tools you currently use and how they speed up your work

3. Your availability and the hours of U.S. overlap you can offer

4. Your expected monthly rate within the $300-$500 range



To show me you actually read this entire posting, please start your message with the word "carousel." Applications that don't start with that word tell me you skimmed, and I'll know.



I'm excited to find someone who can make a lot of great content, fast. If that's you, send your portfolio and let's talk.

title: Accounting Operations Lead | Elevated Hospitality Partners
description:
ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS | ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS LEAD



Philippines - Independent Contractor | Full-Time



ABOUT ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS



Elevated Hospitality Partners supports a growing portfolio of short-term rental property management brands across multiple U.S. markets, including Texas, New Mexico, and California, with over 1,000 total properties.



Our companies manage vacation rental homes on behalf of homeowners, with a focus on excellent guest experiences, thoughtful homeowner communication, strong local operations, and disciplined financial management. As we continue to grow, we are building a centralized finance and accounting function that can support our operating companies with consistency, accuracy, and scalability.



We are looking for an experienced Accounting Operations Lead based in the Philippines to help manage our end-to-end accounting workflows across all markets.



This is not a basic bookkeeping role. We are looking for a high-ownership accounting professional who has existing experience in the U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting space and understands the complexity of homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, vendor payments, tax filing and remittance, property-level accounting, and month-end close across multiple markets.



IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT

- Prior experience supporting a U.S.-based short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality business is required.

- Experience with Guesty is strongly preferred, but not required. Experience with similar property management systems or short-term rental accounting workflows will also be considered.

- CPA certification is preferred.



ROLE OVERVIEW

As the Accounting Operations Lead, you will report to the Chief Financial Officer and be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations across our three short-term rental brands.



You will lead a small team of external and internal bookkeeping and accounting resources. Initially, much of the work will involve managing external bookkeeping and accounting partners, ensuring their work is completed accurately and on time, and taking day-to-day accounting coordination off the CFO’s plate. Over time, this role may help build, train, and lead internal accounting tea
mbers as we bring more accounting processes in-house.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple accounting workstreams at once. You should be able to create structure, identify gaps, follow up on open items, and ensure accounting processes are completed accurately and on time.



WORKING HOURS

This is a full-time role aligned to U.S. Central Time. Required schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time, Monday-Friday.



Central Daylight Time to Philippines Time:

* 9:00am-5:00pm CDT = 10:00pm-6:00am PHT

* Because the Philippines does not observe daylight saving time, the Philippines time equivalent may shift when the U.S. changes between CDT and CST.

* Candidates must be comfortable working overnight Philippines hours on a consistent basis.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

This is a full-time independent contractor role based in the Philippines.

* Base pay: $1,700-$2,300 USD per month, based on experience.

* Compensation at the higher end of the range will be reserved for candidates with direct U.S. short-term rental accounting experience, Guesty experience, homeowner statement and payout experience, CPA certification, and prior leadership of bookkeeping or accounting resources.

* 13th month pay: Offered in December and prorated for partial years.

* PTO: Accrues at 1 paid day per month, usable after 90 days, with no annual rollover.

* Long-term opportunity: This is intended to be a long-term role with the opportunity to grow into a broader accounting leadership position as we continue building our internal finance and accounting team.



YOU WILL OWN

* Day-to-day accounting operations across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast.

* Month-end close coordination across all operating brands.

* Chart of accounts maintenance and accounting structure improvements.

* Homeowner statement review and homeowner payout support.

* Vendor payment workflows and accounts payable coordination.

* Tax filing and remittance support.

* End-to-end accounting flows across property management systems, accounting platforms, banking/payment tools, and reporting processes.

* Coordination and accountability of external and internal bookkeeping resources.

* Accounting SOPs, checklists, calendars, and process documentation.



ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES



ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT

* Manage day-to-day accounting workflows across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast.

* Coordinate accounting activities across multiple markets, brands, entities, and accounting resources.

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for external and internal bookkeeping resources.

* Ensure accounting tasks are completed accurately, consistently, and on schedule.

* Maintain clear accounting task lists, close calendars, open-item trackers, and follow-up routines.

* Identify process gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve accounting workflows.

* Create structure and accountability across the full accounting process.



MONTH-END CLOSE

* Own and coordinate the month-end close process across all operating brands.

* Maintain the monthly close calendar and ensure deadlines are met.

* Review reconciliations, open items, supporting schedules, and accounting workpapers.

* Coordinate with bookkeeping and accounting resources to resolve missing information or discrepancies.

* Prepare summaries of close status, unresolved issues, and items requiring CFO review.

* Support timely preparation of market-level and company-level financial reporting.

* Help ensure each market’s financials are accurate, consistent, and ready for leadership review.



CHART OF ACCOUNTS AND FINANCIAL STRUCTURE

* Help maintain and improve the chart of accounts across multiple entities and operating brands.

* Ensure transactions are coded consistently across markets.

* Support department, market, homeowner, property, and entity-level reporting needs.

* Help create scalable accounting structures that support business growth.

* Document accounting policies, workflows, coding rules, and reporting standards.

* Identify where account structure, classes, departments, properties, or other reporting dimensions need to be improved.



HOMEOWNER STATEMENTS AND PAYOUTS

* Support the preparation, review, and accuracy of homeowner statements.

* Help ensure homeowner payouts are processed accurately and on time.

* Review homeowner charges, owner proceeds, adjustments, deductions, reimbursements, and management fees.

* Investigate and resolve homeowner accounting questions or discrepancies.

* Ensure property-level revenue, expenses, fees, and reimbursements are properly reflected.

* Help maintain clean and accurate homeowner accounting records.



VENDOR PAYMENTS AND PAYABLES

* Manage and improve the vendor payment process.

* Ensure vendor bills are properly received, coded, approved, and scheduled for payment.

* Coordinate with market teams to resolve missing invoices, approvals, W-9s, or supporting details.

* Support payment tracking, vendor statement review, and payables reporting.

* Help ensure strong controls around vendor payments and expense approvals.

* Identify recurring vendor payment issues and recommend process improvements.



TAX FILING AND REMITTANCE SUPPORT

* Support lodging tax, sales tax, occupancy tax, and other required tax filing and remittance processes.

* Track filing deadlines and payment due dates by market.

* Coordinate with internal and external resources to ensure filings are prepared and submitted on time.

* Reconcile tax liability accounts and investigate discrepancies.

* Maintain supporting records for tax filings, payments, and related schedules.

* Help ensure tax processes are documented, repeatable, and scalable across markets.



END-TO-END ACCOUNTING FLOWS

* Manage accounting workflows across systems such as property management software, accounting platforms, payment tools, bank accounts, and reporting tools.

* Support the flow of reservation revenue, guest payments, owner payouts, management fees, vendor charges, taxes, reimbursements, and company revenue.

* Help reconcile data between property management systems, banking/payment platforms, and accounting software.

* Identify broken workflows, missing data, duplicate entries, reconciliation issues, and process gaps.

* Create and maintain SOPs for key accounting processes.



SYSTEMS AND TOOLS

* Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software is required.

* Experience with Guesty is strongly preferred.

* Experience with short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting systems is highly valuable.

* Experience with tools such as Topkey, Breezeway, AppFolio, Buildium, Hostaway, Streamline, Track, OwnerRez, or similar platforms is a plus.

* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills are required.



TEAM AND RESOURCE MANAGEMENT

* Lead a small team of external and internal bookkeeping and accounting resources.

* Assign tasks, follow up on progress, and hold resources accountable to deadlines.

* Review work quality and escalate issues when needed.

* Help train future accounting tea
mbers as the internal team grows.

* Build SOPs, checklists, and process documentation to support future scalability.

* Help create a high-quality internal accounting function over time.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

* 5+ years of accounting, bookkeeping, finance operations, or related experience.

* Prior experience supporting a U.S.-based short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality business.

* Experience with homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, property-level accounting, trust/escrow-style workflows, or similar accounting processes.

* Experience with U.S. accounting practices and working with U.S.-based companies.

* Strong QuickBooks Online experience or experience with similar accounting platforms.

* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.

* Experience managing month-end close tasks and reconciliations.

* Experience coordinating with bookkeepers, accountants, operators, or business leaders.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Ability to work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time.



STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

* CPA certification.

* Guesty experience.

* Experience with short-term rental or vacation rental homeowner statements.

* Experience with homeowner payouts and homeowner accounting.

* Experience with lodging tax, occupancy tax, sales tax, or similar tax remittance processes.

* Experience with multi-entity businesses.

* Experience supporting multiple markets, locations, or operating companies.

* Experience building accounting SOPs and process documentation.

* Experience leading or supervising bookkeepers or accounting assistants.



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

title: Freight Booking Consultant
description:
About Us

We are a growing UK-based business seeking an experienced Freight Booking Consultant to support our ocean freight operations between China and the United Kingdom.



This is a hands-on consulting role for someone with extensive experience managing FOB ocean shipments directly with carriers. In addition to handling day-to-day bookings, you will play a key role in documenting our operational processes by creating a comprehensive Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) that can be used to train our internal operations team.



Trade Lane

Origin Ports

• Tianjin (CNTSN)

• Qingdao (CNTAO)

• Ningbo (CNNGB)



Destination Ports

• London Gateway (GBLON)

• Felixstowe (GBFXT)



Primary Carrier

• CMA CGM



Additional Carrier Platforms

• APL

• ANL

• CNC

• Maersk

• MSC



Key Responsibilities

1. Ocean Freight Bookings

• Manage end-to-end FOB shipment bookings through the CMA CGM Click & Book platform

• Prepare and submit carrier bookings accurately and efficiently

• Select suitable vessel schedules based on transit time, allocation availability, and operational requirements

• Enter and validate shipment details including:

-- Port of Loading (POL)

-- Port of Discharge (POD)

-- Container type and quantity

-- Cargo weight

-- Commodity descriptions

-- HS Codes

• Complete all shipping party information including Shipper, Consignee, Notify Party, Forwarder, Customs Broker, and D
 Party

• Verify freight payment terms and payment locations

• Review booking summaries and secure booking confirmations

• Utilize booking templates and reusable bookings where appropriate



2. Booking Management

• Monitor bookings from confirmation through vessel departure

• Process booking amendments, cancellations, and reconfirmations

• Coordinate cargo readiness against carrier cut-off schedules

• Monitor empty container release dates

• Track Verified Gross Mass (VGM) deadlines

• Monitor Shipping Instruction (SI) submission deadlines

• Resolve allocation issues and communicate directly with carrier booking teams when required



3. SOP Development

• Develop a comprehensive, step-by-step Standard Operating Procedure covering the complete China to UK booking workflow

• Capture screenshots of each stage within the carrier portals

• Create decision trees and workflow diagrams

• Prepare reference guides for carrier processes, booking statuses, and required documentation

• Document exception handling procedures and escalation paths

• Produce SOP documentation suitable for onboarding junior operations staff

• Continuously improve documentation as carrier processes evolve



Required Qualifications

Essential

• Minimum 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in ocean freight operations

• Extensive experience managing China to Europe or China to UK shipments

• Proven experience using CMA CGM Click & Book or equivalent carrier booking platforms (APL, ANL, CNC)

• Strong understanding of FOB Incoterms and associated operational responsibilities

• Experience with the following origin ports:

-- Tianjin (CNTSN)

-- Qingdao (CNTAO)

-- Ningbo (CNNGB)

• Familiarity with UK destination ports:

-- London Gateway

-- Felixstowe

• Experience managing multiple concurrent shipments

• Ability to interpret vessel schedules, ETDs, ETAs, and port cut-off timelines

• Previous experience preparing SOPs, work instructions, or operational documentation

• Excellent written and spoken English

Preferred

• Existing CMA CGM or APL customer portal access

• Established relationships with carrier booking teams

• Experience within a freight forwarding, NVOCC, or 3PL environment

• Knowledge of SOLAS Verified Gross Mass (VGM) requirements

• Understanding of UK import procedures and customs documentation

• Experience obtaining spot quotations through carrier procurement platforms such as SpotOn



Skills

Technical Skills

• CMA CGM Click & Book platform

• Carrier booking systems and e-booking platforms

• Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook

• Shipping documentation including:

-- Bills of Lading

-- Shipping Instructions

-- Dangerous Goods Documentation

-- MSDS

• Process documentation and SOP writing

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail

Soft Skills

• Excellent communication skills

• Strong organisational skills

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Effective time management

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across carriers, suppliers, and freight partners



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review - applications without a clear, specific summary of freight coordination experience will not advance.

2. A 15-minute interview, booked online. Concrete answers about real shipments - the lanes, the problems, and how you closed them - work best. May be followed by a second longer interview if needed.

3. Offer to the candidate who passes - a full-time position paid biweekly, every other Friday, in exchange for 9:00 to 5:00 UK Business Hours availability, Monday through Friday.



How to Apply

Submit your application through this form: 



The application form includes questions about your freight coordination experience, carrier platforms and systems you've worked with, cross-border shipping experience, availability, and expected rate.



Please note: Only applications submitted through the application form will be considered. Applications received without a completed form will not be reviewed.



Once you have completed the form, please send us a message with the subject line: Freight Consultant - [YOUR FULL NAME]
